articleTitle: Implementation of Deep Learning-Based Segmentation Technique on LDCT Scan Images for Detection of Lung Cancer in Early Stages
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Early detection of lung cancer considerably increases the chances of survival and treatment efficacy. This paper studies the use of YOLOv8-based segmentation technique for automatic lung segment detection from LDCT scan images, with the goal of improving diagnostic accuracy and efficiency. The proposed model uses the YOLOv8 architecture, which is adapted for lung nodule identification and distinction in LDCT images through segmentation tasks. This technique makes use of YOLO's real-time object identification capabilities to swiftly and reliably identify troublesome spots. The model undergoes a thorough preparation procedure that includes image normalization, resampling, and augmentation in order to ensure robustness and generalizability. A novel loss function is used for training the model, combining metrics specific to segmentation with traditional object identification loss components. The model's performance is evaluated using metrics such as F1 Score, Recall, Precision, ROC-AUC and Intersection over Union (IoU), which demonstrate how well the model segments lung nodules. According to the study's findings, the YOLOv8-based segmentation method presents a potentially helpful tool for identifying lung cancer in early stages. This might lessen radiologist's workload and enhance patient outcomes by enabling early diagnosis and treatment.

articleTitle: Harmonizing Ensemble Learning Strategies for Enhanced Coronary Artery Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Coronary artery disease (CAD) is a common health issue today that can lead to financial loss, disability, and even death for those with heart problems. In addition to increasing the chances of curing patients, early diagnosis could lead to a reduction in their impermanence as well. Machine learning algorithms are now often employed in medicine and have proven to be reliable, saving both time and lives. In order to enhance precision, Machine Learning models are trained using diverse datasets to attain more accurate results. In this research, our goal is to improve the accuracy of predicting heart disease by training different machine learning models with the aid of these datasets. Rather than having costly medical examinations, we want to cut down on time and money spent. In this way, patients will not have to wait long for multiple tests of this type. This paper demonstrates how advanced machine learning algorithms can help predict CVD using simple medical tests.

articleTitle: FGMOS Based Low Power Analog Subtractor
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel low-power Floating Gate MOSFET (FGMOS)-based analog subtractor designed for bio-signal processing applications. Simulations demonstrate exceptionally low static power dissipation (around 323.25 μW) due to FGMOS technology. The subtractor functions well with bio-signal frequencies (1–100 Hz) and offers a usable bandwidth (16.59 kHz) with minimal distortion (Total Harmonic Distortion < 0.05% for small signals). The noise profile (22.8 nV/ Hz at low frequencies, −14.37 dB/decade roll-off) aligns with biomedical application requirements. These findings highlight the FGMOS subtractor as a compelling building block for low-power, high-performance bio-instrumentation, with future work exploring further power reduction or wider bandwidth for broader ap-plicabllity.

articleTitle: Chronic Kidney Disease Stage Prediction Using SGD with ElasticNet Regularization: A Streamlit Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) is a progressive condition marked by a gradual decline in kidney function. Predicting the stages of CKD accurately is essential for timely interventions and effective disease management. In this study, we present a predictive model that employs Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) with ElasticNet regularization to classify CKD stages. ElasticNet regularization, which combines the benefits of both Ll and L2 regularization, enhances model performance by preventing overfitting and addressing multicollinearity. We evaluate our model using a dataset that includes various clinical and biochemical features. Our findings indicate that the proposed method achieves high accuracy and robustness in predicting CKD stages, surpassing traditional regression methods. This model demonstrates significant potential in assisting healthcare professionals with early diagnosis and personalized treatment planning for CKD patients. The SGD with ElasticNet regular-ization model achieved an accuracy of 85% in predicting CKD stages, the highest among the methods tested. This model has been chosen and deployed as the ultimate predictive system, accessible through a web application built using the Streamlit library.

articleTitle: Soil Moisture Measurement Using Sensor Based on Cloud IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Agriculture is a cornerstone of the Indian economy, with approximately 58% of rural households relying on it as their primary livelihood. Soil moisture is a critical factor in agriculture, affecting plant health, irrigation requirements, and overall crop productivity. Traditional soil moisture measurement methods are often costly and complex, making them less accessible for small-scale farmers and environmental observation. Real-time value of soil parameters like temperature, moisture content, and humidity is crucial for maximizing agricultural production while minimizing costs. The arrival of the Internet of Things (loT) with low-cost microcontrollers like the ESP32 offers a promising solution for developing affordable and efficient soil moisture measurement systems. loT technology enables real-time data collection and analysis by connecting sensors to the internet via Wi-Fi, facilitating better water management in agriculture, environmental monitoring, weather forecasting, and natural resource management. This paper presents a novel, cost-effective, and scalable solution for real-time soil moisture monitoring using an ESP32 microcontroller integrated with a cloud-based Internet of Things (loT) platform. The proposed system provides comprehensive soil health monitoring by measuring moisture content, temperature, humidity, ensuring precision agriculture and sustainable resource management. This integration of loT with Cloud computing-termed ‘Cloud IoT’-c-enhances data security, monitoring, and maintenance while offering flexibility, accessibility, and cost efficiency.

articleTitle: Driver Drowsiness Alert System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: A distracted driver poses a serious risk and leads to serious traffic accidents. This article presents a method using computer vision technology, specifically Python, OpenCV, and a DLib, to detect driver fatigue and warning issues. The system can measure sleepiness by analyzing facial expressions such as yawning, closed eyes, and head movements and can give audio warnings accordingly. Alerts range from mild drowsiness warnings to emergency contacts if the driver continues to shows drowsiness signs. The architecture of the system includes processing video from cameras and monitoring vital signs such as eye closing time and yawning frequency. In addition, the design of the system prioritizes the safety of the driver, helping to increase road safety and reduce accidents due to drowsy driving.

articleTitle: Decoding Information: A Dual Modality Approach for Sign Language Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Sign language is an important transmission method through which people who have hearing impairments or have difficulty in hearing properly communicate with other people. In sign language, each sign or gesture is assigned a different meaning. But communicating through sign language can be challenging as there are still crowds that have no idea about it therefore to solve this issue there are many sign language recognition tools present but they can be used by people who have a basic idea of sign language. A dual modality approach has been proposed, so this tool can be used by both the users who know sign language as they can use the sign-to-text recognition model which uses Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), and the users who do not know sign language can use the audio to text converter model which uses Speech Recognition Python Module. It can be used by a broader community. Our model has been trained on 26 alphabets and has achieved an accuracy of 98%.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Diabetic Retinopathy Recognition with Advanced Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is a severe complications arising from diabetes and the primary cause of vision impairment worldwide. Early recognition is essential for efficient intervention and prevention of permanent vision loss. This research focuses on using Deep Learning Techniques (DLT) for accurate and efficient recognition of DR. It utilizes a dataset of retinal images from diabetes, covering several stages of DR progression. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), is DLT subset, are employed for extracting features and performing classification. The proposed model effectively detects subtle retinal abnormalities indicative of DR. This research contributes to existing methods by introducing a novel deep learning approach that shows high specificity and sensitivity in DR detection. The DR-Color-Fundus-Images recognition using DLT were analyzed using available Color-Fundus-Retina datasets. Performance metrics, comprising the area beneath the curve receiver operating characteristic, specificity, and sensitivity, validate the model's accuracy. The outcomes have implications for developing automated screening tools, enabling timely intervention and improving healthcare outcomes for individuals with diabetic retinopathy. This research represents a significant advancement in harnessing deep learning for enhancing DR detection and highlights the importance of technological progress in ophthalmic healthcare.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Hybrid CNN+RNN and BiLSTM for Fake News Detection in Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Distinguishing counterfeit news is an essential undertaking in the contemporary era of digital technology. Fabricated news refers to information that has been deliberately fabricated or manipulated and is then published as legitimate news to mislead readers or viewers. To maintain the reliability of information sources and promote well-informed decision-making, It is imperative to combat the spread of inaccurate information. This paper tries to provide a brief insight into the deep learning/machine learning based approaches which have been provided recent times to counter fake news detection Specialists have explored various approaches to detect and prevent the dissemination of false information. This work is the analysis of some methods for detecting false information in the healthcare domain by utilizing Hybrid CNN+RNN and BiLSTM.

articleTitle: Enhancing Microservice Reliability in Cloud Environments Using Machine Learning for Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Microservices-based applications benefit from rapid growth and development in cloud environments with container technologies such as Docker. However, assuring the reliability of these microservices is now a top priority for application providers. Anomaly detection techniques are important because they can discover activities that could lead to unexpected failures. To guarantee excellent service quality-virtualization services necessitate advanced dependability and availability measures. Traditional monitoring systems identify overloads and outages-and they automatically scale services or disguise errors. However, these systems frequently overlook the oddities and errors that precede faults. To close this gap-we proposed to use Machine Learning (ML) methods to identify suspicious activity by evaluating measurements from all levels and components of the cloud architecture. This strategy seeks to discover issues before they cause outages-hence-improving service dependability and availability. Offline evaluations of data from anomaly injection experiments revealed that these ML models have extremely high accuracy, precision, and recall values. This suggests that the proposed approach is extremely effective in detecting abnormalities and preventing future failures-hence-increasingthe reliability of microservices in cloud environments.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Analysis of a Ge/GaAs/Si-Based DG-JL-TFET for Ultra Low Power Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: This paper introduces a detailed investigation of the design and performance of a new type of transistor called the Ge/GaAs/Si-based Double-Gate Junctionless Tunnel Field-Effect Transistor (DG-JL-TFET). The transistor is specifically designed for use in ultra-low power applications. The proposed DG-JL-TFET utilizes the distinctive material properties of germanium (Ge), gallium arsenide (GaAs), and silicon (Si) to achieve enhanced electrical performance while minimizing power consumption. This addresses the limitations of current structures, including random doping fluctuations, low current driving capability, and ambipolar behavior. The inquiry utilizes a mathematical and computational methodology to simulate and enhance the device's properties. The work utilizes statistical modeling techniques to investigate the effects of variations in key geometric factors, such as gate length (L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</inf>), oxide thickness (tox), and channel thickness (tch). Polynomial words are utilized to numerically represent these variables, facilitating a comprehensive investigation of their impact on device performance. For this analysis, the current when the device is not in use is set at a constant value of 9.6 femtoamperes, resulting in a current of 6.7 milliamperes when the device is in use. The construction additionally decreases the threshold voltage to 0.35 V, while achieving a ft value of 744 GHz and a fmax value of 855 GHz. The findings emphasize the capability of the Ge/GaAs/Si-based DG-JL-TFET to provide improved switching efficiency and energy conservation, positioning it as a promising contender for future low-power devices.

articleTitle: Leveraging QR Code Technology for Efficient Form Automation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: In the mobile computing domain, efficient data processing is paramount as user expectations lean heavily towards rapid and reliable interactions. This paper introduces a novel application that leverages QR code technology to streamline the form-filling process through automation, enhancing user experience while ensuring robust security and scalability. Developed over 16 weeks, this application integrates advanced programming languages and API technologies. The primary aim is to assess the feasibility and effectiveness of QR codes in automating data entry and management across diverse industries such as healthcare, finance, and education. The application architecture consists of a mobile platform and a web interface, supported by a backend API facilitating seamless data flow and real-time updates. Methodologically, the project involved rigorous development and testing phases, focusing on functionality, user engagement, and operational effectiveness. The testing results were significant: the application reduced the time required for form filling by approximately 80-85% and decreased paper usage by 40%, thereby not only enhancing operational efficiency but also contributing to environmental sustainability. These outcomes underscore the potential of QR code technology in transforming data-intensive tasks within mobile environments, suggesting substantial productivity gains and cost reductions across sectors. Future enhancements will focus on improving QR code recognition under adverse conditions and expanding digital tool integration to widen the application's utility.

articleTitle: Stock Price Prediction with Fine Tuning of Support Vector Machine Using Sea Lion Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: One of the most prominent exercises people do is foresee the stock market. While attempting to predict an exact price of the stock is a futile attempt, we can accurately identify the direction, in which the stock price will move. A large number of the elements that influence the stock market come in the form of news items. Because traders are quickly swayed by what they read, the sentiments that users derive from news headlines have a significant impact on their purchasing and selling behaviors. Our research presents a hybrid technique that integrates the Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Sea Lion optimization algorithm (SLnO). Hyperparameters (kernel function, Regularization parameter, Kernel coefficient) of SVM are optimized using SLnO. Optimized SVM is employed to foresee the intraday close price movement. We have used Nifty 50 historical data from Yahoo Finance and sentiment scores from news headlines aggregated from Pulse (Pulse by Zerodha,2020) to assess the proposed hybrid strategy. According to the experimental findings, the hybrid SVM and SLnO model performs better than the benchmark model.

articleTitle: GUA:A Multi Point Cursor Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: In today's digital world, it's crucial to have strong ways of confirming someone's identity. Traditional passwords, which rely on remembering text, are hard to remember and can be easily targeted by cyber attackers. This has led to the investigation of new, more secure options. Graphical User Authentication (GUA) is one promising solution. It uses images and memory to make security stronger and make it easier for users. This paper looks closely at GUA, evaluating methodologies, bringing together what we already know, looking at how it's done, and seeing how it's used in the real world.

articleTitle: Impact of Macro Economic Variables and Information Asymmetry on Mutual Fund's AUM in India; A VECM and E- GARCH Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Macroeconomic risks can create disruptions among various asset classes globally and has potential to affect investors perception towards any investment alternative and mutual funds in India are not an exception to this. It is one of the burgeoning investment alternatives in India which has observed manifold expansion over a few decades with Assets Under Management of 10 trillion. This research uses the Vector Error Correction Model (VECM) and the E-GARCH model on a 10-year monthly data set from 2012 to 2022 to detect information asymmetry and evaluate the impact of macroeconomic conditions on the AUM of different mutual fund types. It is found that the role of macroeconomic factors is noteworthy in explaining the variations of AUM in various types of mutual funds. Information asymmetry exists in all kinds of mutual funds except Equity and Debt oriented open-ended schemes.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation for Hybrid Energy Harvesting System for Remote Monitoring Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: This study addresses the demand for sustainable energy systems in remote monitoring scenarios, particularly for Wireless Sensor Networks and IoT apparatuses. It introduces a hybrid approach to energy harvesting that utilizes both solar power and kinetic energy from piezoelectric sources, aiming to develop dependable and efficient power solutions that support extended operations in isolated settings. By integrating the solar and piezoelectric technologies, the proposed system ensures a continuous energy supply, crucial for the uninterrupted functionality of remote sensors. The implementation of ESP8266 modules facilitates WiFi connectivity, allowing data transmission to ThingSpeak platforms for effective data visualization and analysis. This configuration not only enhances the capability for real-time remote monitoring but also maximizes the operational lifespan of the sensor network without the need for frequent maintenance or battery replacements, thereby offering a significant advancement in the sustainability of IoT deployments.

articleTitle: Real Estate Price Prediction Model Analysis Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The research illustrates use of ML algos in the field of housing price prediction. The models have been analyzed on real datasets downloaded from Kaggle created by Amitabha Chakraborty. We know that the source on the research of ML prediction in India are scarce, but we encounter conditions which pose need of efficient methodologies to solve this problem. This research gives a glance about the use of ML techniques on the dataset. After careful analysis of data processed and running tests in multiple ways, the results indicate the best suited algorithms for this work.

articleTitle: Depression Diagnosis using Restricted Crossover and Mutation Based Whale Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Whale optimization algorithm (WOA) and Genetic Algorithm (GA) are very effective soft computing techniques. Numerous soft computing methods, such as evolutionary and swarm intelligence, have been used to identify the best features needed for the diagnosis of psychiatric diseases, such as depression, anxiety, and stress. A novel hybrid feature selection method called RCM-WOA, which is based on the principles of genetic algorithm with some restriction on crossover and mutation and Whale Optimization technique has been proposed as a solution to the feature selection problem. In addition, the outcomes of the suggested approach are contrasted with nine distinct soft computing methodologies.

articleTitle: Indigenous IoT and Software Framework for Implementing Digital Twin Over Indian Region Towards Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Digital Twin is a digital replication of physical things. This technology has been in works for over a decade, and has been implemented in various regions. This study shows the integration of Internet of Things(IoT) with the Digital Twin technology seamlessly within the Indian ecosystem to lead towards sustainable development. The Digital Twin model utilizes the data collected through an indigenous IoT solution equipped with LoRa technology and Node MCU. However, with the diverse geographic properties of the Indian subcontinent, it poses a significant challenge to collect comprehensive data of the entirety of the region. This paper presents an approach to develop an indigenous and integrated solution to simplify the complexities of integrating data from the sensors spread across the region into one simple framework. This paper further present show this Digital Twin model can play a huge role in showcasing data received from indigenous IoT devices to nroduce more accurate and actionable insishts.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling for Type-3 Diabetes: A Machine Learning Approach for Healthcare Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Diabetes Mellitus (DM) is a prevalent metabolic illness that needs to be accurately diagnosed and predicted in order to be effectively managed. Using datasets including the NC State University Diabetes Dataset and the Ohio Longitudinal 2023 Dataset, this work examines predictive modeling techniques for diabetes classification and Type-3 Diabetes (T3DM) forecasting. We use an assortment of machine learning methods, preprocess data, and perform exploratory data analysis. The hybrid technique achieves the most accuracy of 81.1% for diabetes classification. It does this by combining the predictions of gradient boosting and logistic regression classifiers. Furthermore, we create a T3DM predictive model that has outstanding predictive ability to identify people who are at risk. The hybrid algorithm's application demonstrates how well it works to increase prediction accuracy over the use of separate models. Our findings highlight the value of predictive modeling in managing diabetes, assisting in the making of healthcare decisions, and enhancing patient outcomes. Subsequent investigations may concentrate on incorporating supplementary data sources and utilizing sophisticated techniques to improve clinical relevance and predictive precision in the treatment of diabetes.

articleTitle: Development of Weather Forecast Application Using API
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: This research paper presents the development of a weather forecasting model that incorporates real-time data through Application Programming Interfaces. This model utilises simple algorithms to analyse meteorological parameters from diverse API data sources, aiming to improve forecast accuracy compared to traditional methods. Extensive datasets are used for training and validation, demonstrating the model's effectiveness in providing more precise predictions. The study highlights the significance of API integration in advancing weather forecasting methodologies and fostering innovation in the field. The model created has yielded highly reliable results with minimal error.

articleTitle: Performance Enhancement of IoT LoRa Network for Mobile Devices based on Improved AMILCC Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: In Internet of Things (IoT) networks, long-range (LoRa) technology is well-known for its wide communication range, but using it with mobile devices presents unique difficulties. Frequently occurring channel attenuation, which causes packet loss, increased energy consumption, and longer transmission times, is one of these difficulties. An improved Adaptive Mobility-based IoT LoRa Clustering Communication (AMILCC) strategy addressed to solve these problems. AMILCC partitions the network into optimal Spreading Factor (SF) areas by using a 2D random waypoint mobility model. The Hybrid Adaptive Data Rate (HADR) technique, which combines intra-and inter-SF region modifications to improve resource allocation for mobile IoT LoRa devices, is a key component of AMILCC. The simulation findings demonstrate the advantages of AMILCC over conventional stationary techniques, even under low mobility conditions (up to 5 m/s). In particular, AMILCC decreases energy usage by 56.5%, improves packet success ratio (PSR) by 72 %, and decreases end-to-end delay by 45.32%. These outcomes demonstrate how well AMILCC works to enhance efficiency and performance for mobile LoRa applications.

articleTitle: Detection of Fake Profiles and News on Social Media Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Technology is advancing rapidly every day, becoming an integral part of our lives and helping people connect with each other through social media and online news outlets. But as everything has its own advantages and disadvantages, it has too, and this paves a way for individuals to make fake news and accounts that are posing a major threat to society. This paper tries to incorporate a strategy utilizing Machine learning algorithms. Random Forest, Support Vector Machines and Neural Network are some of the algorithms which are used to distinguish fake profiles on social media and for detection of fake news online Naïve Bayes' and LSTM are utilized. Hence, detection of fake profiles and fake news online is possible using the above-mentioned frameworks. The outcome illustrates the ability to distinguish between fake and real profiles using extracted features by applying trained machine learning models. Naive Bayes, k-nearest neighbor, and Poisson calculation independently give precision of 87%, 88.3.5%, and 91.2% individually. The proposed approach shows that the algorithm neural networks system has an accuracy of 94.3%. The proposed work uses the machine learning approach for detection of tampered profiles on social media platforms.

articleTitle: Enhancing Image Segmentation through an Innovative Hybrid Kernel: A Weighted Fusion of Sobel and Prewitt Operators Using Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Image segmentation, a pivotal element in computer vision, relies on effective edge detection to delineate boundaries within images. Traditional methods, including Canny, Sobel, Prewitt, and Laplacian, while widely used, may exhibit limitations that necessitate pre- and post-processing techniques for optimal results. In response to this, our paper introduces an innovative hybrid kernel, constructed from the weighted average of Sobel and Prewitt operators, with weights determined through an Artificial Neural Network (ANN). The objective is to synergize the strengths of these operators, enhancing the precision of edge detection. The proposed hybrid kernel is rigorously evaluated against established techniques, such as Sobel and Canny, utilizing comprehensive metrics like Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) and F-score. Results consistently demonstrate that the hybrid kernel outperforms previously published outcomes, showcasing notable improvements in edge detection quality and accuracy. This research positions the hybrid kernel approach as a promising alternative for image segmentation, offering advancements beyond conventional methods.

articleTitle: Malware Detection Technique for Android Devices Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The increasing popularity of Android devices has raised concerns about the growing risk of malware. Malicious apps can compromise data security, disrupt device functionality, and invade user privacy. Traditional methods of detecting malware based on signatures need help to keep up with the evolving software landscape. This study introduces an approach to identifying Android malware using machine learning (ML) techniques. By extracting features of Android apps such as permissions requested by Android applications the method trains ML models to distinguish between benign and malicious applications. The effectiveness of these models is ensured using a comprehensive dataset. The paper also explores the performance of ML algorithms like Logistic Regression (LR), Support Vector Machines (SVM), Decision Trees (DT), Random Forest (RF), k-Nearest Neighbors (k-NN), Neural Networks (NN), Gradient Boosting Machines (GBM), Naive Bayes (NB), AdaBoost (AdaB), XGBoost (XGB) in detecting malware. Practical aspects like efficiency and scalability are discussed, emphasizing how these methods can seamlessly integrate into Android security solutions. This research represents a step in detecting Android malware offering improved protection against emerging security risks for Android users. The results show that RF obtained the highest accuracy of 97.20<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> using the NATICUSdroid (Android Permission) Dataset for malware detection for Android devices.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling for Crop Recommendation Using Machine Learning Techniques for Agricultural Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: This work aims to develop a predictive model for recommended crop using machine learning techniques. The dataset, containing various soil attributes, was initially loaded and preprocessed by extracting latitude and longitude information from the location data, removing unnecessary columns, and one-hot encoding categorical variables such as soil type. The independent variables were defined as all relevant features except for recommended crops, which served as the dependent variable. The dataset was then split into training and testing sets, and the features were scaled to ensure consistency. Several machine learning models were trained, including random forest classifier, Support Vector Machine (SVM) regressor, neural network, decision tree and multinomial naive bayes. Each model's performance was evaluated based on metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score. The models were compared to determine the best performer. This work provides a comprehensive approach to suggest recommended crop based on the minimal environmental parameters, which is crucial for efficient agricultural practices and resource management.

articleTitle: Audio-Enhanced Video-to-Audio Retrieval Using Text-Conditioned Feature Alignment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The pace of technological advancement has accelerated significantly. Videos and images have ingrained themselves into daily life. Large amounts of generated video data can be used for real-time analysis. These days, it can be used to improve healthcare and video search. This essay tackles the issue through content analysis. This paper addresses audio feature extraction and multilingual and multicultural considerations. The method in the paper takes videos as a dataset. In this paper, it uses the genism model to extract the matching feature. The similarity table value for different words is between 0.55 to 0.77. The score graph is between 0.4 to 0.8.

articleTitle: Experimentation Analysis of VQC and QSVM on Sentence Classification in Quantum Paradigm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The quantum computing made complex computations may be executed at light speed, superpositions allow for parallelism, and massive quantities of data can be efficiently processed. Furthermore, researchers and engineers are quickly becoming interested in natural language processing (NLP) as a topic for developing more comprehensive computational models of NLP. Therefore, there is hope for future progress in NLP efforts that use quantum technology, especially in emotion classification. In this study, we use quantum computing models to delve deeply into two sentiment categorization approaches. To be more specific, the effectiveness of the models is evaluated by looking at VQC and QSVM. The analyzed models are evaluated by simulations in the Qiskit simulator and the real-time quantum computer Qiskit_ibm_osaka. Results demonstrate the importance of the experiment and validate it using positive predicted value, sensitivity and Fl-Score as performance metrices.

articleTitle: An Efficient Machine Learning Based Optimization Framework to Analyse the Short-Term Solar Energy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: A short-term prediction of solar energy is absolutely necessary in order to maximize the efficiency with which solar power plants utilize energy. The aim of this research is to enhance the precision and efficiency of solar energy forecasts by introducing an innovative system that merges the Random Forest Classifier (RFC), a machine learning method, with the Election-Based Optimization Algorithm (EBOA). The proposed system utilizes the Request for Comments process for feature selection and model creation. Additionally, the Evolutionary Biogeography-Based Optimization Algorithm (EBOA) is employed to fine-tune the model parameters, leading to significantly improved prediction performance. Typical measures such as Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE), and R-squared (R2) coefficient are used to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed model. Test results show that the RFC-EBOA method performs better, than existing approaches in terms of predicting efficiency. The results imply that the proposed framework excels over methods, in prediction precision.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning-Based Framework for the Detection of Big-4 Snakes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Snakebite incidents pose a significant public health concern, with venomous snake species contributing to fatalities and medical emergencies. India accounts for the highest number of snakebites and is called the capital of snakebites globally. Despite advancements in medical treatment and antivenom supplies, precise and timely identification of snake species remains difficult. Among venomous snake species, “Big-4” snakes known as spectacled cobra, Russell's viper, common krait, and saw-scaled viper, stand out due to their prevalence and lethal potential. Computer-aided diagnosis has recently proven helpful in analyzing snake images and in the field of herpetology. This research article evaluates the performance of deep learning models, including VGG16, DenseNet, InceptionV3, and EfficientNet, in accurately classifying the Big4 snake species using image data. The evaluation of the proposed models is conducted using 1000 snake images collected from iNaturalist.org and the Kaggle repository. In the proposed work, EfficientNet has achieved an accuracy rate of 97.69%, surpassing the performance of VGG16, DenseNet, and InceptionV3 models. The EfficientNet demonstrated substantial computational efficiency, with each training epoch requiring approximately 43 seconds. In comparison, DenseNet demonstrated an accuracy rate of 93.69%, followed by InceptionV3 with 90.92%. Moreover, VGG16 attained an accuracy rate of 90.04%. These results highlight the potential of EfficientNet as a robust solution for accurate snake species classification, offering both high accuracy and computational efficiency. Overall, the proposed study contributes valuable insights into utilizing deep learning techniques to address critical challenges in snakebite management and wildlife conservation.

articleTitle: Arduino Nano Based Low-Cost Auto Shoelace Tightening Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: This work deals with the challenges involved with the fastening of shoes. It is very difficult for specially-abled, old people and kids to tighten their shoelaces. Poorly fitting shoes can result in causing various side effects and can lead to damage to your feet. This work focuses on building a model for shoelace tightening. Prior work on these technologies was mostly implementation-focused and did not take cost and renewability into account. We build a functioning and comprehensive” Auto Shoe lace tightening system” using various low-cost hardware components. The aim of this model is to provide a low-cost auto-shoelace tightening model. This model uses a servo motor coded using Arduino and connected to a mobile application using a Bluetooth module. Then for testing, this model is incorporated into the shoe, and performance of the proposed model is measured in terms of comfort and battery usage.

articleTitle: Strengthening Plant Disease Detection Using Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Deep learning approaches have been applied to the agricultural sector to resolve several challenges, such as crop disease detection, yield prediction, irrigation management, etc., faced by farmers. Detecting and classifying plant diseases at an early stage is crucial for taking measures to prevent crop failure. In this paper, disease detection and classification of tomato plants is discussed. Experimentation involves transfer learning methods using deep learning models such as DenseNet201, InceptionV3, ResNet50, MobileNetV2, InceptionResNetV2, and Xception, along with a proposed ensemble learning model that integrates a voting ensemble of these models. The dataset contains 18,160 images divided into 10 classes. Among the individual models, DenseNet201 achieved the best accuracy at 94.54<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>whereas the proposed ensemble learning outperformed against the sate-of-the-art approaches.

articleTitle: Hybrid Machine Learning Framework for Predicting Gender-Based Crimes: Integrating Socio-Economic and Regional Factors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: This research addresses critical gaps in current hybrid machine learning models for risk assessment in gender-based crimes and crime prediction frameworks. Existing models focus on predicting crime occurrences but fail to specify the types and severity of future offenses. Additionally, these models lack comprehensive prevention strategies, overlook broader socio-economic factors influencing crime rates, and are often limited in their regional applicability. Using Spain's VioGen system as a case study, this paper proposes a new model framework that not only generalizes across different cultural and legal contexts but also integrates real-time socio-economic indicators and advanced data visualization tools for user-friendly, dynamic interaction. Furthermore, we consider the impact of post-pandemic conditions, such as increased isolation and stress, on gender-based violence patterns. By addressing these gaps, the research aims to enhance crime prediction accuracy, prevention strategies, and overall public awareness tools.

articleTitle: Enhancing Capabilities of Recommendation System for Electric Vehicles Using Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: In the future, electric vehicles, including automobiles, motorcycles, and public transport, are expected to play a significant role in daily commutes. However, India's current infrastructure lacks a wellestablished and integrated network of charging stations to support this growth. This application aims to bridge that gap by providing electric vehicle users with detailed information about charging stations, including availability, status, number of chargers, and compatibility with their vehicles. Users can also book chargers in advance for a hassle-free experience. A key feature of the application is the ability to plan longdistance trips by mapping out routes with real-time information on charger locations and availability, ensuring access to functional chargers throughout their journey. This application includes a review section where users can share feedback, helping others make informed decisions about where to charge. For businesses, the application offers specialized subscription services to companies like Uber that operate electric vehicle-based taxis, allowing them to book entire charging stations and access administrative features. Additionally, small businesses and private charger owners can register their chargers for public use, contributing to the charging network while ensuring transparency and reliability for users through real-time data sharing.

articleTitle: Enhancing Precision Agriculture: Computer Vision-Aided Farm Boundary Detection and Crop Land Identification From Drone-Captured Image
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: In the current technological era, Artificial Intelligence has played a significant role in addressing various challenges faced by people. Within the realm of Artificial Intelligence, computer vision emerges as a crucial subdomain with profound implications for agriculture. It is instrumental in tasks such as enhancing crop production, detecting diseases, and implementing precision and smart farming techniques. Unmanned Aerial Vehicles or drones represent another technological advancement that profoundly influences the collection of field data in agriculture. These devices navigate over designated areas, capturing images of fields, which are subsequently processed to extract pertinent information. This study leverages images acquired through drones, focusing on agricultural fields consisting of multiple plots. The research employs the Canny edge detection algorithm to segment the plots, and the Probabilistic Randomized Hough Transform algorithm to identify plot boundaries. Further, the work identifies areas within the plots where plants are present. To achieve this, the HSV (Hue, Saturation, Value) color space is utilized for processing drone images. The extracted boundary information holds paramount importance for autonomous UAVs and Unmanned Ground Vehicles. These vehicles utilize such information to optimize activities such as planting, harvesting, and pesticide or fertilizer application. Additionally, the delineation of plot boundaries offers farmers an accurate map of their fields, contributing to more efficient agricultural practices.

articleTitle: Prediction Of Environmental Impact Of Types Of Polyethylene: The Deep Analyzing Of “Danger”
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: In this Research work, we specifically used data science techniques to examine how different or we can say various kinds of polyethylene affect the environment. Our objective is to divide the polyethylene into the three different impact categories i.e. High, moderate, and low. However, in order to do this, we gathered a lot of information on various polyethylene varieties and furtherly examined that how they affected the land, atmosphere, and water. Here, Statistical models as well as machine learning algorithms were utilized in our approach or method to forecast the environmental impact of the polyethylene by taking into the account its Human usage and also disposal patterns. The highest risk is posed and also presented by the polyethylene with high impact, which negatively impacts and also harms all the three environmental factors, according to this analysis. Moreover, Low-impact polyethylene, showed very few negative effects, while indicating that it is a safer and more environmentally friendly choice. This study emphasizes and highlights that, how important it is to select the low-impact polyethylene in order to reduce the environmental harm. Moreover, our research also offers very useful information to the consumers, manufacturers, and also policymakers to help them to make more ecologically conscious decisions. Finally, in the end, this study also emphasizes how vital it is to use sustainable methods in the production and also the use of polyethylene in order to safeguard and also maintain our ecosystem.

articleTitle: AI and ML-Based Gesture Recognition and Communication System for Combat Vehicles in Adverse Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: In contemporary warfare, communication breakdowns within armoured fighting vehicles present critical operational hurdles. Traditional audio channels are prone to jamming and interception, potentially jeopardizing the efficacy of military manoeuvres. This paper introduces an innovative gesture-based communication system specifically tailored for armoured fighting vehicles operating in hostile environments. The system seamlessly integrates flex sensors within gloves and harnesses a camera-based recognition framework to accurately interpret hand gestures. Employing Python and the MediaPipe library for gesture recognition and flex sensor data processing, this system establishes an alternative communication channel resilient against audio interception. Furthermore, through a dedicated machine learning algorithm, the system amalgamates inputs from both sensor types, ensuring rapid and reliable transmission of crucial messages. This solution endeavours to bolster communication reliability in armoured vehicles, furnishing a secure conduit for transmitting vital information to crew members or ground control stations while effectively mitigating risks linked to audio channel vulnerabilities.

articleTitle: Generation of Super - Resolved Images Using Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: High-resolution aerial imaging is crucial in the field of military applications for gathering intelligence and devising strategic plans. This research examines super-resolution approaches, with a specific emphasis on three Deep Learning Neural Models: Super-Resolution Convolutional Neural Networks (SRCNN), Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN), and Super-Resolution Generative Adversarial Networks (SRGAN). The study does a rigorous comparison investigation of these models, with the goal of determining their effectiveness in producing high-resolution aerial photographs. In order to conduct a thorough evaluation of these models, a wide range of datasets is utilised, which includes MNIST, Fashion MNIST, DIV2K, and DOTA. This extensive range of options enables a comprehensive evaluation of the models' performance across a wide range of data complexities, ranging from simple geometric forms to complicated real-world aerial landscapes. This research offers detailed analysis of the datasets, allowing for a thorough examination of the strengths and shortcomings of the models. It provides valuable insights into how these models might be applied to real-world military situations. The results of this study have important consequences for military intelligence. Efficiently generating super-resolved aerial images can improve target recognition, terrain analysis, and threat assessment. Furthermore, comprehending the relative strengths of various models enables military agencies to customise their image processing approaches to meet unique operational needs. This research facilitates the integration of modern deep learning techniques with the complexities of military intelligence, thereby enabling better informed decision-making processes and eventually strengthening national security operations.

articleTitle: A Study of Fake News Detection Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The number of people using the Internet has significantly expanded due to the advancement of information and communication technology. It converts people's conventional news and information consumption habits into online ones, benefiting news broadcasters and readers by enabling comfort, speed. These days, massive false reports (news) are constantly uploaded by hostile clients with deceitful objectives, prompting calamitous social consequences for people and society and making ceaseless dangers a majority rule government, equity, and public trust. It is especially significant in online entertainment stages (e.g., Snapchat, Twitter, Facebook) because to their inherent, unrestrained publishing methods and platforms. Same issues have determined the work of the academic world as well as enterprises for growing more precise fake news recognition. In this paper, different machine learning methods are introduced, which are implemented in other datasets to observe which method is most efficient in this field.

articleTitle: Prediction of Diabetes Using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Diabetes is a chronic disease posing a significant global health challenge, with the number of affected individuals projected to nearly double by 2045. This disease, which is characterized by high blood sugar, can cause severe complications such as kidney failure, blindness, and heart problems. To address this pressing concern this study target to enhanced machine learning technology-based system for the early understanding of diabetes with high accuracy. The suggested method makes use of the output of different technique, such as Decision Tree, Random Forest, K-Nearest Neighbor and Naive Bayes, to maximize their benefits and enhance overall prediction performance. The study evaluates the accuracy of each algorithm individually and selects the techniques with the best result as the final predictive system. The results of this study support ongoing initiatives to apply innovative data science methods for diabetes early diagnosis and treatment, ultimately assisting in the avoidance of the disease's severe consequences and enhancing patient outcomes. Based on the Random Forest classifier model, this model generated an accuracy of 96.83%.

articleTitle: Skin Cancer Detection using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Skin conditions are among the most common health issues in the world; they are frequently hidden but can bephysically and psychologically painful. Skin cancer may even result from severe cases. One major challenge in medical image analysis is the challenging issue of identifying these disorders from clinical photographs. Expert manual diagnosis takes a lot of time. Computerized skin disease prediction is clearly needed to speed up treatment planning. This study suggests a novel strategy that combines a number of methodsto improve the precision of skin disease detection. We present anew digital hair removal method that makes use of morphological filtering, which includes the inpainting algorithm and the Black-Hat transformation. Gaussian filtering thereafter reduces noise and blur in the images. From skin picture images, the Grey Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) is utilized to identify important underlying patterns. Using the newly acquired knowledge, certain efficient machine learning algorithms are applied, including K- Nearest Neighbor (KNN) classifiers, Random Forest, and Support Vector Classification (SVC). These classifiers categories skin images into categories including melanocytic nevus (NV), melanoma (MEL) and basal cell carcinoma (BCC) based on the features that have been gathered. Out of all machine learning models Random Forest has more accuracy and classification of images as Random Forest otters Hierarchical Feature Extraction, Data Augmentation, High Performance, Enhanced Data Use, etc. By amalgamating digital image enhancement, segmentation, feature extraction, and machine learning, accurate classification of diverse skin conditions is achieved.

articleTitle: Automated Identification of Pneumonia Employing Convolution Neural Networks and the VGG-16 Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Pneumonia, an inflammatory lung disease, impacts the small air sacs known as alveoli and is typically caused by the bacteria Streptococcus pneumonia. Symptoms commonly include a combination of productive or dry cough, chest pains, difficulty breathing, and fever. In India, where Covid-19 is prevalent, community-acquired pneumonia (CAP) poses a significant risk factor for mortality, accounting for one-third of fatalities, as reported by the World Health Organization (WHO).Diagnosing and predicting the outcome of pneumonia typically involves examining chest imaging radiographs of patients exhibiting clinically similar symptoms (e.g., fever, dyspnea, cough, and sputum production). Therefore, the development of an automated method for pneumonia detection could offer valuable advantages, particularly in remote regions, facilitating prompt treatment. Deep learning (DL) models enable the analysis of various chest radiographs, with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) receiving considerable attention in disease classification. Leveraging features learned.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Root-Finding Methods for Nonlinear Functions Using Python Programming Language
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: This research paper presents a comprehensive comparative analysis of root-finding methods for nonlinear functions using Python programming language. The study focuses on three widely used methods: Newton-Raphson, Secant, and Bisection, evaluating their performance in terms of accuracy, efficiency, and rate of convergence. Through empirical testing and analysis across various functions, including algebraic, exponential, and trigonometric functions, the paper examines the strengths and limitations of each method. The program utilizes two essential Python libraries: SymPy for symbolic computation, and Matplotlib for visualizing the convergence rates of various methods. Exception Handling is implemented to manage edge cases, ensuring the robustness of the program. The results demonstrate the varying efficiency of each method, with Newton-Raphson typically showing the fastest convergence, particularly in cases where the function is well-behaved near the root.

articleTitle: Leveraging Neural Networks for Fine Grained Twitter Sentiment Analysis in the Context of Depression During Covid
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has significantly affected mental health globally, leading to a noticeable rise in anxiety, depression, and other psychological challenges. This study aims to explore the correlation between the pandemic and depressive symptoms expressed on social media, specifically Twitter. By applying fine-grained sentiment analysis using neural networks with a hybrid approach to word embedding, we analyzed tweets to detect depressive sentiments. The proposed model achieved an accuracy of 98.130/0, outperforming existing methods due to its ability to capture both contextual and sentiment nuances. This research provides insights into how digital platforms reflect societal mental health trends during crises and emphasizes the importance of real-time sentiment analysis for public health monitoring. Our findings indicate that the percentage of depressive sentiments in COVID19related tweets was significantly higher, reinforcing the link between global crises and deteriorating mental health.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection Using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Brain tumour detection through medical Imaging is the most challenging and time-consuming procedure. A medical specialist may use magnetic resonance imaging, also known as magnetic resonance imaging, as a diagnostic technique to show the internal structure of the tissue. Brain tumors can be determined using magnetic resonance imaging, which offers detailed information about sensitive human tissue. Accurate MRI image segmentation is necessary for clinical equipment powered by laptops to diagnose brain cancers. This essay focuses on the optimal and most suitable method for identifying neoplasms from brain magnetic resonance imaging scans and whether or not it validates the existence of a tumor. The author is an Associate in Nursing. We have demonstrated through an experiment that our anticipated methodology has higher accuracy than several current approaches.

articleTitle: Sustainable Energy Production Through Piezo Electric Tile
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel method for harnessing vibrational energy from footsteps and vehicle movement using piezoelectric sensors embedded in tiles. With India's ambitious goals for renewable energy production, this technology offers a cost-effective and efficient solution to generate electricity in high-traffic areas such as railway stations, airports, and toll plazas. The methodology involves constructing specially designed tiles equipped with sensors and springs to convert vibrations into electricity. Through Experimental calculations and hardware observations, this paper demonstrates the potential for substantial renewable energy production without additional operational expenses.

articleTitle: Deep Vision: Iris Segmentation for Diagnostic Insights in Iridology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Ocular diseases, particularly diabetic retinopathy, are increasingly prevalent and necessitate precise detection methods. The proposed method, “Deep Vision: Iris Segmentation for Diagnostic Insights in Iridology,” leverages deep learning for enhanced prediction of diabetes-related ocular conditions. Data from the diabetes-iridology dataset is pre-processed with Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) [1]. The Attenuation-based U-Net model [2] ensures precise iris segmentation. For improved classification, DenseNet [3], EfficientNet [4], and Capsule Networks (CapsNet) [5] are evaluated. The Python-based implementation achieves an impressive accuracy rate of 95.87% [6], demonstrating a substantial improvement over conventional method. This approach not only advances diagnostic performance but also sets a new benchmark for precision in ocular disease prediction.

articleTitle: Advancements in Facial Image Processing for Human Age and Gender Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: With the increased usage of social media and associated cyber frauds, current scenario demands for authenticated information. This in turn necessitates for the valid and verified information of individuals from various resources which are available online. Various examples of cyber fraud include: fake banking transactions, unauthorized access to various organizations’ resources, fake online proxy for absentees through biometric system etc. To counter such issues, in this paper we have targeted facial image processing for Precise age and correct gender recognition which are the most crucial factors in the digital era. Thus, in this study, we have constructed two distinct approaches to figure out human age and gender from facial with a satisfactory runtime and efficiency. Our method uses image processing to examine specific features from facial images of people in different age groups that have been adjusted. It then creates binary masks, performs edge detection, and measures wrinkle densities. To make assessing easier, we developed the ADIENCE facial database, containing images of males and females spanning various age ranges. The database holds twenty-six thousand plus photos featuring more than two thousand individuals sorted by gender and grouped into eight age categories. This special database has been used to train computer program for identification of individual's face based on their age and gender. This has been done by using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) which makes it easier for program to recognize age and gender from pictures of people's faces. This is definitely going to help in various domains where security is top concern. This can also be helpful in healthcare domain for medical diagnoses.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Study on Wearable Substrates
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: There is a considerable amount of research in the field of wearable wireless communication and sensing using micro strip patch antennas which has opened new avenues for wearable devices that un-conditionally need a compact structure with a decent amount of gain and efficiency. These types of antennas can also be made conformal so as to fit into a complex structure of wearable devices. Varieties of substrate materials are available, which results in cheaper and useful variants of antennas. The study focuses on conformal substrate materials for applications in wearable devices. Following a thorough examination of the aforementioned subjects, the article concentrates on the integral difficulties and potential applications of conformal antennas.

articleTitle: A Novel Image Processing Approach for Antibiotic Susceptibility Testing via Disk Diffusion Method
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing (AST) stands as a cornerstone in modern healthcare, necessitating precise and prompt detection of resistance patterns to guide antimicrobial stewardship. Traditional clinical microbiology techniques, while accurate, suffer from time-intensive protocols and often lead clinicians to resort to empirical antimicrobial therapies. Disk diffusion testing, a widely employed method for determining antimicrobial susceptibility, entails manual measurement of the zone of growth inhibition around antimicrobial disks, posing challenges in efficiency and standardization. To address these issues, automated or semiautomated inhibition zone readers have been proposed. However, existing readers are often costly and necessitate significant changes in laboratory infrastructure and workflow. In response to these limitations, we present a novel tool designed to semi-automate the process of measuring and categorizing inhibition zones, reading antibiotic names, and generating reports.

articleTitle: Intelligent IoT-Enabled Real-Time Monitoring System for Logistics Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Result of growing digitalization and mastering the Internet Of Things (loT) is seen in logistics, one industry sector that has been revolutionized by these technologies. With the increasing need for tracking and tracing activities, efficiency of logistics has been demanding real-time monitoring to have transparency on logistic network ensuring that it is secure. This article discusses some of those troubles related to logistics management and the requirement for real-time asset, vehicle tracking that can be resolved by this study. Many current systems lack the integration and up-to-the-minute data needed for efficient management of logistics. This study suggests and implements the Internet of Things (loT)-based logistics management system where a unique hybrid model involving both hardware as well software solutions perceiving for improving standard functional demand in move competently implemented with cloud-based server. The whole system is designed to enable real-time monitoring via sensors, GPS tracking and data analytics that allows a look into all logistics operations. The results show that the proposed system improves tracking accuracy, process efficiency and also decisions-making power. This system provides real-time data that responds quickly to any disruptions or inefficiencies by generating alerts, improving overall logistics management. The study is limited by the hardware used and specific logistics test cases. We would suggest for further research to investigate the implementation of more sophisticated AI algorithms within CT and expand its application possibilities into other logistics environments. In the future, we will continue to strengthen our system by introducing machine learning algorithms for prediction analysis and including different types of loT devices as well apply this on a larger scale in multiple logistics environments to re-verify its sustainability.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach of Human Stress Rate Monitoring System in Smart Society 5.0

articleTitle: FFDM − GNN:A Financial Fraud Detection Model using Graph Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Financial Fraud Detection Model (FFDM) is used to develop an advanced detection framework utilizing Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to accurately identify fraudulent transactions within the transactions. Traditional fraud detection systems often struggle with the dynamic and intricate nature of fraudulent activities. In this paper, we introduce an innovative fraud de-tection model leveraging the power of Graph Neural Networks (GNN) to address these challenges. Our model synergistically combines the strengths of graph-based learning with deep neural networks to effectively capture the complex relationships and patterns inherent in financial transactions. By utilizing a multi-layered approach, our GNN model not only identifies anomalous patterns indicative of fraud but also adapts to evolving fraudulent tactics.A key feature of our model is the integration of node and edge features, which enhances the representation of transaction networks.

articleTitle: Exploring the Role of Artificial Intelligence in Predictive Analytics for Financial Markets
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has the potential to improve forecasting accuracy, enhance risk management, and streamline decision-making, there has been an increasing amount of interest in integrating AI into financial market predictive analytics. This study offers a thorough examination of the ways in which artificial intelligence (AI) methods, including machine learning and deep learning, increase financial market forecasting. It looks at a variety of AI-based models and algorithms that are used to predict financial risk factors, stock prices, and market trends. Additionally, the paper addresses opportunities and challenges related to implementing AI in financial prediction and suggests future research avenues.

articleTitle: Concatenated PSO and GWO based Approach for Mobile Robot Path Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: This work inspects the mobile robot path planning and provides an approach for single robot path planning using algorithms that are inspired by nature. Among various nature inspired algorithms PSO is widely adopted by the researchers due to its ease of use and favourable results for path planning. This work provides a concatenated PSO and GWO based approach for single robot path planning. The efficiency of this proposed approach is verified by evaluating its performance in a simulation environment for different target locations and comparing it to the performances of other approaches as well.

articleTitle: EEG Brain Emotion Classification Using AI
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Emotion recognition from EEG brain signals is a challenging yet crucial task in affective computing and neuro informatics. In paper, we file a DNN-based approach for automatic emotion classification using EEG data. Our method utilizes a multilayered architecture comprising CNNs and RNNs to absorb ranked representations from raw EEG signals. We explore various preprocessing techniques to enhance the discriminative power of the model and employ transfer learning strategies to hold instructed neural network models for feature extraction. The framework is resulted on standard datasets, demonstrating promising results in accurately classifying emotional states. Our findings highlight the potential of deep neural networks in grasping difficult patterns in data and the field of affective computing towards real-world applications in mental health monitoring and humancomputer interaction.

articleTitle: A Simulation-Based Analysis of IoT Security Architecture in Smart Homes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The rise of smart homes, driven by the Internet of Things (IoT), promises enhanced convenience and efficiency but also presents significant security challenges. This paper, “A Simulation-Based Analysis of IoT Security Architecture in Smart Homes,” investigates the effectiveness of different IoT security architectures in smart homes through simulation. By simulating potential attacks and analyzing their impact, the research identifies weaknesses and proposes more se- cure systems. Furthermore, the integration of Hyperledger Fabric technology into the smart home framework is explored, highlighting its potential to provide robust encryption, secure authentication, and advanced threat detection across all IoT architecture layers. This integration ensures a highly secure and efficient environment for IoT devices and user interactions within the smart home ecosystem This study aims to contribute to the development of secure, reliable, and efficient smart home systems capable of withstanding the increasing complexity and connectivity of IoT devices. this study paves the way for a safer and more secure future for smart home technology, leveraging both simulation-based insights and cutting-edge blockchain solutions.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Recognition of Handwritten Devanagri Character
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: A framework known as optical character recognition is capable of converting handwritten or printed pictures into machine-editable structures. Several Indian dialects, including Hindi, Nepali, Marathi, Sindhi, and others, use the Devanagari script. In India, Hindi is the national language and the language that is spoken by most people. This script organises the development of the language. Nowadays, people are interested in gathering data in sophisticated configurations that are available in paper archives and then employing a search process to reuse this data later. In this study, we provide a novel approach to Devanagari script character recognition for printed Hindi characters. The principal objective of this research is to identify the consonants and the vowels, which can subsequently be used for recognizing the complicated inferred words. The primary focus of this project is on the identification of each individual consonant and vowel. Several pre-processing techniques, including feature extraction, segmentation, and classification, have been researched and used in this project to create an advanced Hindi OCR system. The K-NN classification technique was used in earlier research; however, in the work that is being suggested, we have employed a hybrid technique that combines neural networks with K-NN. The recognition rate of the suggested approach is 97.4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, whereas that of the existing techniques is 94.5%. This suggests that the approach which proposed here is superior to techniques employed in the method which already exist.

articleTitle: Integrating Context and Criteria in Hotel Recommendations: A Deep Learning Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Recommendation systems are widely utilized to personalize user experiences by sorting and providing information based on user preferences. Multi-Criteria Recommendation Systems (MCRs) enhance basic recommendation systems by considering user ratings and interactions across various criteria. When contextual information is also integrated, these systems become Context-Aware Multi-Criteria Recommendation Systems (CA-MCRs). This paper explores the use of Deep Neural Networks (DNN) in CA-MCRs for making predictions. The incorporation of deep learning in recommendation systems is relatively new and offers higher accuracy compared to traditional methods, as evaluated by RMSE and MAE scores. Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) facilitate efficient feature extraction through embedding layers, eliminating the need for manual intervention. The model is tested on TripAdvisor data, which includes multi-criteria ratings of various hotels. Our approach proved its supremacy by demonstrating the efficacy of deep learning in enhancing recommendation accuracy.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study of Available and Prospective Object Detection Methodologies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Visual recognition and recognition of objects have created a new field of relevance in modern times, posing severe issues for computer vision. Object detection technology is increasingly being used in a variety of applications, the most noteworthy of which include surveillance systems, self-driving vehicles, and pedestrian identification. One of the most significant and difficult issues is visual identification and obj ect detection, which has enticed an area of significance in modern years. The most well-known applications of object detection include surveillance, self-driving automobiles, pedestrian detection, and other areas of daily life. The primary objective of visual object detection is to recognized objects that fit into a certain targeted object with excellent navigation in a real scene or input image, as we know to assign a specific class label to each object instance due to the rapid growth of deep learning models, the performance of object detectors has significantly boosted, deep learning-based detection algorithms have been extensively investigated once again. This paper provides a comprehensive overview of the most recent advancements in visual object identification using deep learning and also describes a huge corpus of recent research and used it to analyses conventional and modern obj ect detectors. Here this study discussion the backbone architecture for obj ect recognition, followed by a methodical deconstruction of existing learning algorithms. Some important datasets and metrics for objects detection are also explored. Finally, this paper describes object detection applications and suggests various future directions.

articleTitle: Graph Neural Networks for Fraud Detection in E-commerce Transactions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: E-commerce platforms face increasing fraud, resulting in significant financial losses, and traditional fraud detection approaches often fail to capture complex patterns.
