This paper proposes a Graph Neural Network approach to enhance fraud detection by modeling e-commerce data as a graph, where nodes represent consumers, sellers, and transactions, and edges represent interactions. By utilizing a multi-layer Graph Convolutional Network and message-passing algorithms, the GNN captures intricate relationships, uncovering hidden fraud patterns through local and global node interactions. Trained on a large-scale, real-world dataset, this method significantly outperforms traditional approaches like logistic regression and decision trees, demonstrating its superior ability to detect sophisticated fraud in e-commerce environments.

articleTitle: Exploring Hand Gesture Recognition for Enhanced Human-Computer Interaction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Hand gesture recognition is a key advancement in human-computer interaction, enabling real-time interpretation of hand movements from video. This technology is useful for applications like volume control, where it provides an intuitive, non-contact way to interact with devices. The main challenge is accurately recognizing gestures made by a single hand. This research introduces a new method that combines shape-based feature recognition with adaptive thresholding to enhance gesture accuracy and minimize errors. A Haar-cascade classifier is used to detect hand regions efficiently. A single camera captures user gestures, which are then processed in several steps: capturing the gesture, segmenting and identifying the hand in video frames, and recognizing the gesture based on its shape. The adaptive thresholding technique adjusts sensitivity based on hand size and distance from the camera, improving performance in different conditions. This method allows for accurate and efficient real-time hand detection. The goal is to create a system that can identify specific gestures and control devices without physical input devices like keyboards or mice, making interaction more convenient and accessible. The research demonstrates the design of this gesture detection system, highlighting the use of adaptive thresholding and its potential applications. The findings propose that such systems can considerably improve user experience by offering a user-friendly interface for controlling devices. Real-time gesture recognition provides a way to interact with computers through simple hand movements, with potential applications extending to sign language interpretation and other areas of human-computer interaction.

articleTitle: Development of Remote Health Monitoring System for Elderly using IoT and WSN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: In today's rapidly evolving world, numerous people encounter difficulties in accessing medical services for minor health issues. To tackle this problem, we introduce a robust pulse monitoring system that also checks room temperature and humidity. This system harnesses cutting-edge technology to deliver live health and environmental information directly to medical professionals, allowing them to evaluate a patient's health remotely and offer immediate medical guidance or action. The setup includes essential hardware components like the NodeMCU ESP8266 microcontroller, the DHT11 sensor for temperature and humidity measurement, and a pulse sensor to monitor the patient's heart rate. The data from these sensors is sent to the cloud-based service ThingSpeak using the ThingESP library, making it available for healthcare providers to review and act upon. Moreover, the system incorporates TWILIO, a communication service, to facilitate WhatsApp messaging that alerts healthcare professionals instantly in the event of unusual health or environmental readings. This pioneering approach ensures that individuals can obtain prompt medical support and surveillance from their homes, enhancing proactive health management and ultimately improving health outcomes.

articleTitle: Secure Fog Enabled Blockchain Based Healthcare Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Cloud Computing introduced high latency, mobility, bandwidth, etc., which Fog Computing addressed. Fog Computing streamlines remote IoT device and sensor management. However, Fog-Cloud has security and privacy issues. Blockchain gives trustless security, subsequently its utilization in various fields is developing. We propose an electronic healthcare framework that oversees basic and non-basic patients all the while. Basic and non-basic fog bunches make up the fog layer. Basic patients are treated in basic fog bunches for fast reaction, while non-basic patients are taken care of utilizing blockchain innovation to save patient wellbeing records. The proposed technique reduces key message response time and offloads cloud infrastructure with minimal IoT ecosystem changes. The results demonstrate that the suggested method protects privacy while maintaining network settings. The aim of the research is to create a safe healthcare system that combines blockchain with fog computing.

articleTitle: Driving Efficiency: A Literature Review of Energy-Efficient Data Collection Strategies for Mobile Sink-Based Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Portable sinks assume a vital part in information assortment within wireless sensor networks (WSNs), offering dynamic and flexible solutions to address the limitations of static sink-based architectures. Unlike their static counterparts, mobile sinks have the capability to traverse the network, adapt their trajectories, furthermore, gather information straightforwardly from sensor hubs. This versatility empowers a few critical benefits in information assortment proficiency, energy streamlining, and network execution upgrade. This survey paper presents an extensive outline of the writing on energy-effective information assortment plans for portable sink- based remote sensor organizations (WSNs). With the expansion of Web of Things (IoT) applications, WSNs have become integral for collecting data from the environment in various domains. However, traditional static sink-based approaches suffer from energy imbalances and limited network lifespans. The integration of mobile sinks offers a promising solution to these challenges by enabling dynamic data collection and energy-efficient routing.

articleTitle: A Noise Attack Resistant Blind 3D Watermarking Algorithm for IP Rights Protection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: In this era where innovation is reaching new heights, and individuals are making strides in development daily, it has become the need of the hour to ensure that due credit is given to the work to maintain originality and prevent the theft of ideas in the scientific community. With respect to 3-D objects, this study provides mechanisms to embed watermarks - which would be the owners verified image - into the main image, wherein we will test for its robustness against noise attack while keeping the capacity (memory size) and imperceptibility of the watermark in mind. Embedding a 2D watermark into a 3D object is a novel and innovative approach in the field of digital watermarking which is achieved by embedding watermarks into the mesh structure of 3D objects. The attacks were tested against Mushroom, Nefertiti, Pipes and Sphere 3D objects in the study. For the pipes, 98.55 % of the original watermark is recovered, which is the best result considering that 30 % of the faces are warped. The ideologies were derived from the context of steganography and cryptography. Employing an enhanced form of steganography within 3-D objects, detecting it using attacks, and verifying its robustness were the major points of research.

articleTitle: Adopting Support Vector Machine Algorithm for Fault Diagnosis in Polymer Impeller Centrifugal Pump
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: With rapid advancement and application of polymer materials in current pumping industry, it is important to continuously monitor the health of the system. In this research work, an experimental study is conducted on a centrifugal pump with semi-open polymer impeller installed on the rotor shaft of the pump. Pump data with healthy and faulty features are extracted using vibration and temperature signals from the pump. Correlation matrix shows a good correlation among selected variables and classifier SVM with three kernel functions viz. RBF, linear and polynomial are used on extracted data for diagnosing fault accuracy. Result depicts high accuracy of classification of faults by polynomial kernel function as compare to RBF and linear kernel function.

articleTitle: A Review on Coconut Disease Detector Using Various Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The most significant and primary source of income in the economy of the southern region of India is the production of coconuts. Recent observations have shown that the majority of coconut trees are afflicted with diseases, which progressively weaken and reduce the amount of coconut produced. Diseases caused by pests and deficiencies in nutrients affect the majority of tree leaves. Our primary focus is on improving the livelihood of coconut leaves and early disease detection to maximize the benefits of coconut production for farmers. Monitoring of coconut leaves has been done with the assistance of pesticides and fertilizers — the best methods for image processing and machine learning. Automatic recognition will prove advantageous and the quickest method for accurately identifying diseases in coconut leaves, as opposed to relying on human experts. The most suitable classifiers were determined to be SVM and CNN, with accuracy rates of 93.54% and 93.72%, respectively. The project's results will undoubtedly revolutionize the agriculture industry and assist farmers in increasing their output of coconuts.

articleTitle: Exploring Deep Learning Approaches for Epileptic Seizure Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: A seizure is an uncontrollable electrical disruption in the brain that modifies movement, sensations, behaviour, and consciousness. Individuals with epilepsy are likely to suffer recurrent seizures. Seizures based on EEG data have been classified using deep learning and machine learning techniques to aid in epilepsy identification. In this work, LSTM, Bi-Directional LSTM, Stacked LSTM, and GRU are checked to obtain the most suitable classification model. The model is then utilized to identify the class of the testing data. Also, the accuracy, precision, and sensitivity of the model are determined in Two-Class Classification, Three-Class Classification and Five-Class Classification for obtaining reliable results.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis of Techniques and Applications in Multimodal Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning has gained popularity and been used in many different applications. Models that can process and link data utilizing several modalities are the aim of multimodal deep learning (MMDL). Even with all the advancements made, unimodal learning is still unable to fully capture the entirety of human learning. Multimodal learning facilitates a better understanding and analysis of situations in which information is processed through multiple senses. The various modalities covered in this article include picture, video, text, audio, flow, RGB, stance, depth, face expressions, body motions, and point clouds. There has been a thorough examination of the most current developments in multimodal deep learning applications in the last few years, as well as a detailed investigation of the baseline methodologies. A detailed taxonomy of distinct multimodal deep learning techniques is presented, providing further details on specific applications. Finally, key issues are outlined for each domain separately, along with potential avenues for further research.

articleTitle: Advancing Wheat Leaf Disease Classification for Sustainable Agriculture Using EfficientNet
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The world-wide threat of leaf disease has a great impact on the food security. The prior identification of these threats affects the quality and the wheat crop productivity. This article proposed an approach that automate the leaf disease classification. It uses hybrid approach of Machine Learning (ML) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The prior identification of illness helps to manage the quality-based food production in significant manner. ML performs several operations such as feature extraction and data augmentation which is a baseline for the performance in early diagnosis. Efficient Net-based CNN architecture is used for classification of leaf images that outperforms in accuracy. This mechanism provides 95.12 accuracy in early diagnosis in test set. It accurately determines the illness of wheat leaf. This work highlights how this proposed approach helps farmers to determine prior diagnosis of illness of wheat leaf. For bigger dataset, it utilises transfer learning and can be used in the applications of agricultural domain.

articleTitle: Region-based Convolutional Neural Network (RCNN) Model for Detecting Healthcare Fraud Spam
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Ensuring the safety of patient care and the authenticity of the healthcare delivery system relies on rooting out fraudulent practices. Using the Region-based Convolutional Neural Network (RCNN) deep learning (DL) model, this research offered a unique technique to the identification of fraudulent activity in the healthcare industry. The RCNN model is trained on a dataset that contains spam data linked to healthcare. This dataset includes a variety of fraudulent acts, including identity theft and fake claims, along with other types of fraudulent activity. Using painstaking preprocessing, feature engineering, and model tuning, the RCNN architecture displays better performance in reliably identifying and localizing fraudulent patterns within healthcare data. Within the framework of the healthcare sector, this is achieved. Evaluation criteria like as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score are used to verify the effectiveness of the suggested strategy in comparison to conventional methods of fraud detection. The RCNN technique has demonstrated a performance improvement of 12.192 %, 13.475 %, 5.775 %, and 4.705 % when compared to existing approaches such as SVM, DT, CNN, and LSTM. In addition, ethical problems concerning patient privacy and the interpretability of models are discussed, with an emphasis placed on the significance of responsible deployment in healthcare systems.

articleTitle: Real-time Plant Disease Detection and Pesticide Application System Using IoT and CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Globally, farmers use pesticides for improved crop yield and quality. The manual method of applying pesticides cause fatigue, harm to farmers health and application of pesticides in an indefinite proportion on the crops may be less or more in quantity then requirement. This project is aimed to build a 2-D CNN model using deep learning algorithm for plant disease detection and also this research paper outlines the idea of integrating ESP-32 microcontroller with the plant disease detection model to automate the process of pesticide dispensing. This will use image recognition model to identify the damaged crop. By using this technique, the time and work of the farmer will be reduced.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis: Analyzing Flipkart Product Reviews using NLP and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is highlighted as an essential tool for understanding consumer sentiment, with a particular focus on Flipkart product reviews. This paper provides a comprehensive review, drawing from a wide range of scholarly sources. It compares various sentiment analysis algorithm such as naive bayes, logistic regression, and support vector machines, utilizing methodologies from prior research that incorporate machine learning and natural-language-processing techniques. By examining these approaches, the paper delves into the complexities of sentiment analysis on e-commerce platforms. It also identifies existing gaps in the literature and stresses the need for further investigation in this rapidly growing field. Through an in-depth analysis of previous efforts, the paper offers valuable insights into the effectiveness of different sentiment analysis methods, thereby providing guidance for future research and practical applications.

articleTitle: Boosting Rice Crop Management: Disease Detection by Leveraging Transfer Learning in CNNs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: This project introduces a novel Rice Leaf Disease Detection System utilizing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Transfer Learning. The objective is to mitigate the risks that diverse diseases, including the most prominent and frequently occuring diseases bring to rice crops and their potential to drasti- cally reduce productivity. For efficient crop management and the security of the world's food supply, timely and precise detection is essential. The dataset for training and validation comprises high-quality rice leaf images, ensuring robust model performance throughout a range of disease instances and environmental circumstances. The architecture of CNN is tailored to obtain intricate information from illustrations of rice leaves,enabling accurate differentiation between healthy and diseased leaves. Transfer learning techniques fine-tune pre-trained CNN models to optimize detection performance, minimizing the need for exten- sive computational resources. The remarkable precision attained in recognising and categorising rice leaf diseases through the utilisation of CNNs suggests the auspicious possibilities of deep learning models within the realm of plant disease identification. Farmers in areas where rice is grown will find special value in this research as it provides a useful tool for quickly and accu- rately identifying illnesses, facilitating timely decision-making to safeguard agricultural yields and quality in real-time agricultural systems.

articleTitle: A Metaheuristic Approach for Optimal Tuning of PIDDα Controller for AVR Performance Improvement
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: This paper presents an effective controller design technique for the automatic voltage regulator system where an additional fractional-order derivative term is incorporated along with the standard PID controller structure, resulting in the PIDD <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\alpha$</tex> structure. The proposed controller is tuned using a recently reported metaheuristic optimizer, namely the Manta Ray Foraging Optimization Algorithm (MRFOA). Average per-formance for the proposed approach is studied by considering various performance metrics. Comparison with those of the recently reported controllers of different types demonstrates significant improvement in rise time (0.0682 s) and settling time (0.1044 s) along with competitive peak overshoot characteristics (0.75%) for the proposed MRFOA-PIDD<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${}^\alpha$</tex> controller.

articleTitle: Implementation of IoT-Enabled Automatic Solar Power Tracking System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: In order to maximize the performance of solar panels, this paper outlines a systematic approach for creating a tracking system for solar power. The solar power tracking system is a hardware/software prototype that helps solar panels automatically align with the sun at the right time to generate the most electricity. Light Dependent Resistor (LDRs) sensors, solar panels, servo motor, and an Arduino UNO microprocessor are the main components included in this system. By increasing their exposure to sunlight throughout the entire day, the system improves the effectiveness and output of solar system. This study describes the solar panels' ability to detect the light and rotate in response to the sun's location. The solar power tracking system prototype has been designated for use in future. In the proposed setup, it is found that at 12:00 noon, the single-axis tracking system achieves approximately 63.64% higher output power efficiency compared to the fixed-tilt system.

articleTitle: Optimizing the Early Detection of Heart Disease with Improved Feature Selection Using Machine Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Cardiovascular disease(CVD) deaths has increased from 12.1 million in 1990 to 20.5 million in 2021. Traditional machine learning methods for CVD detection are often chal-lenging to select optimal features. This paper mainly focuses on The ECG signal Preprocessing, feature extraction and ECG beat classification phases comprise the three stages of this methodology. To extract the wavelet coefficients and to de-noise the signal, one uses the Discrete Wavelet Transform. Each ECG beat's characteristics are provided as inputs to the classifier. A dataset comprising approximately 2000 The ECG signals are taken from the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database. These signals undergo preprocessing to ensure uniformity and readiness for analysis. Subsequently, feature extraction is performed to distill relevant information from the signals. For classification purposes, two distinct algorithms [1] are implemented named as Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Decision Tree are compared with Depth wise Convolutional Neural Network(CNN), Each Algorithm receives the preprocessed signals as input, which are then subjected to feature extraction. Following this, the classifiers are trained and tested on the extracted features [2]–[4] to discern their effectiveness in accurately classifying the ECG signals.

articleTitle: Enhancing Two-Factor Authentication with Dynamic Ring-Based Password Transformation for Secure Login Processes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: This research introduces a novel user authentication approach that combines two-factor authentication (2FA) with a dynamic password transformation system using rotating rings. During login, users input their password, and two concentric rings independently, generate a new password based on the input and their random positions. We analyse the enhanced security and usability of this method, showcasing its robustness in preventing unauthorized access while maintaining accessibility. The findings highlight the effectiveness of this dynamic ring-based approach in providing secure and user-friendly authentication for various applications, contributing to the advancement of digital security systems.

articleTitle: Safeguarding Tomorrow - Fortifying Child Safety in Digital Landscape
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: This abstract aims to present a strategic direction in implementing a content restriction system as a means to address various concerns on children's exposure to inappropriate content online. It will be implemented with decentralized identity technology to create a safe and age-appropriate digital environment where children can explore, learn, and have fun without being exposed to the inappropriate content. Such a strategy is important in enhancing the mental and emotional wellbeing of the child while improving their access to educational content. It also fosters positive online interactions where the child interacts with ethical peers and behaves well. This is very crucial considering the rampant cases of cyberbullying and online harassment. According to the National Center for Missing and Exploited Child, more than 21 million cases of child exploitation were reported between 2013 and 2021, hence the need for effective protection mechanisms.

articleTitle: Q-Net Compressor: Adaptive Quantization for Deep Learning on Resource-Constrained Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Deep Neural Networks offers a high rate of accuracy, extensive, parameters, and intensive computational requirements that often characterize these networks. Due to high memory consumption and energy usage, this results in significant challenges when deploying DNN s on hardware-constrained devices. This paper introduces the “Q-Net Compressor,” a novel solution for installing substantial neural (Tao, Hou, et al. 2022) network training on constrained resources edge devices. Utilizing adaptive precision levels to maintain model functionality while reducing memory and computation demands. The Q-Net Compressor, implemented with TensorFlow and Keras, offers flexibility across diverse deep-learning architectures, striking a balance between significant model size reduction and the preservation of predictive power. This innovative approach contributes to the evolving deep learning model compression field with quantization, bridging the gap between computational demands and resource constraints. This research paper presents the implementation and evaluation of various quantization techniques on a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model trained using a COVID-19 dataset. The study aims to investigate the effects of quantization on model accuracy and size reduction. The CNN model is trained on a dataset containing COVID-19 images, and different quantization techniques are applied to the trained model. The techniques include post-training quantization, quantization-aware training, scalar quantization, vector quantization, centroid quantization, uniform quantization, non-uniform quantization and hybrid quantization methods. The results demonstrate the impact of each technique on the model's accuracy and size, providing insights into the trade-offs between model performance and computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Navigating Bangalore's Real Estate: A Study Based on a Novel Property Price Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: This paper presents an encompassing analysis of property price prediction using three different ML algorithms: Multi Linear Regression (MLR), Random Forest (RF), and XGBoost(XGB). The study utilizes a novel dataset - Bangalore Property Valuation Data comprising various property features to train and evaluate the models for accurate price estimation. This study fosters investor confidence and facilitates efficient allocation of resources within the economy. This study's outcome and results contribute to the advancement of property price prediction methodologies, enabling stakeholders to make more informed decisions in real estate transactions and investment strategies. The research contributes valuable insights into lever-aging machine learning techniques for property price prediction and offers a roadmap for future research in this domain.

articleTitle: Dual-Axis Solar Tracker: An Efficient Budgetfriendly Way to Utilize Solar Energy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: In order to improve solar energy collecting, this study investigates the development of an affordable dual-axis sun tracking apparatus. This technological attempts to increase efficiency by continuously altering the orientation of solar panels to follow the course of the sun throughout the day, as solar power gains popularity worldwide as a clean alternative to fossil fuels. The study begins with a historical overview of solar energy evolution and focuses on practical implementation using basic components like solar panels, servo motors, and light sensors. By constantly adjusting based on sunlight angles, the dual-axis system boosts energy generation efficiency. Mathematical calculations optimize panel angles for maximum sunlight exposure. Its affordability and practicality provide a sustainable solution for regions with abundant solar radiation, such as India. This research highlights the dual-axis system's potential to promote sustainable energy practices, reduce fossil fuel dependence, and mitigate environmental impact. Its cost- effectiveness makes it viable for widespread adoption in residential and commercial settings, contributing to increased global solar energy use.

Author Keywords: solar power tracking system for the sun

articleTitle: Digital Signature Security Enhancement: Using X-OR Operation on RSA and AES with 4096 Bits Key Length
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: In the face of escalating digital threats, the robustness of cryptographic techniques, especially digital signatures, is paramount for ensuring data integrity and authenticity. The impact of Digital Signatures has increased to a great extent while communicating through the digital messaging. It is very important to protect the important message that is being sent from the sender to receiver from some third party trying to access the message. Integrity and non-repudiation are the two key aspects of cryptography that Digital Signatures try to maintain. The objective of this paper is to provide high level security to the sender as well as the receiver with the kind of system that the authors has designed. The system designed is very robust and practical to implement which reduces the brute force due to its high complexity. In the implementation section RSA and AES algorithms are combined for designing this system. The private keys for both the AES and RSA has been converted to 4096 bit from 256 bits in order to reduce the chances of error. Then the XOR operation is performed on both these private keys to get a combined private key which is highly secure. Similarly, 4096-bit public key is also being generated for the decryption process. Once the message is reached to the sender with digital signature, it is then being decrypted to check the integrity of the message. As result, the proposed method (digital signature generation) is able to implement and work in different kind of applications.

articleTitle: A Systematic Review of Federated Learning Mechanism for The Internet of Medical Things
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The rapid evolution of healthcare technology, no-tably the integration of the Internet of Medical Things (loMT), has revolutionized patient care, diagnosis, and treatment method-ologies. However, this progress introduces substantial challenges, primarily concerning the security, privacy, and interoperability of sensitive medical data. Federated Learning, a decentralized ma-chine learning approach, emerges as a possible solution to address these difficulties since it allows for collaborative model training without requiring raw patient data exchange. This systematic review explores and evaluates various FL mechanisms tailored for 10MT applications. The review examines existing literature, encompassing the amalgamation of loT and healthcare, the challenges faced in traditional health care systems, and the role of FL in mitigating these challenges. It highlights applications, privacy-preserving techniques, security measures, advantages, limitations, and potential enhancements in utilizing FL within 10MT environments. The review also presents a structured methodology for evaluating FL paradigms, encompassing performance metrics, privacy/security analysis, advantages/limitations assessment, and comparative analysis. Moreover, the paper pro-poses an innovative framework for federated learning in 10MT, detailing its architecture, modules, algorithms, functionalities, ethical considerations, and expected impact. Through a comprehensive analysis and synthesis of existing literature and proposed strategies, this review aims to provide insights for health care stakeholders in selecting and implementing optimal FL strategies for collaborative medical advancements while upholding stringent data privacy and security standards in 10MT.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Based Data Transfers for Mobile Healthcare Apps with Security
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The safe and smooth transfer of data across intercepting nodes is a crucial component of data processing in the medical field. Transmitting error-free, unduplicated data is achievable when third-party entities are effectively eliminated and direct connections between the patient and healthcare provider are maintained. Blockchain technology offers a secure method for exchanging information through nodes and connections, ensuring the safety of transactions and potentially addressing current limitations. Currently, the medical data exchange is provider-centric, insecure, sluggish, and often incomplete. These issues arise from fundamental, structural, and semantic inoperability, which impede data interchange. By utilizing blockchain technology with the appropriate markers, patient data security during transfer can be ensured. This research assesses the possibility of future use of distributed ledger technology in mobile healthcare settings.

articleTitle: Armor Guard: Revolutionizing Motorcycle Safety with Smart Helmet
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Motorcycle accidents continue to be a significant concern worldwide, with riders facing various risks on the road. In response to these challenges, The design and development of a smart helmet system, intended to improve rider safety and encourage responsible riding, is presented in this study. The smart helmet integrates cutting-edge technologies and innovative features to provide a comprehensive safety solution for motorcycle riders. Key functionalities of the smart helmet include advanced navigation assistance, seamless call management, proactive accident detection, real-time alcohol detection, fog removal, and backlight indicators. These features are designed to improve visibility, prevent accidents, and ensure compliance with safety protocols. The smart helmet has a safety feature that prevents the vehicle from turning on unless the person wearing the helmet follows specific safety requirements. Additionally, an LED stripe integrated into the helmet's visor assists in fog removal, while a backlight indicator at the back of the helmet enhances visibility to fellow riders. Testing and evaluation of the smart helmet system demonstrate its functionality, reliability, and effectiveness in real-world scenarios. Response time testing confirms the system's prompt detection and response to various events, such as helmet activation and accident detection. The research also identifies areas for future work, including the integration of advanced sensor technologies, enhanced communication and connectivity, AI and machine learning applications, and improvements in energy efficiency and user experience.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approaches for Blockchain Scalability Through Sharding Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Sharding technology creates new difficulties even as it helps traditional blockchain networks overcome performance issues. The distribution of malicious nodes may be unequal because of random node allocation, resulting in performance variations and security threats. Current reputation-based sharding techniques frequently ignore node performance features and don't take care of leader election security issues. Furthermore, complete sharding reorganization significantly lowers the blockchain's overall performance in terms of overhead and time. In this work, we present a reputation-based dynamic reorganization network sharding strategy that provides alternate leaders to preserve the stability of the sharding system while also integrating node performance and behavioral aspects into the reputation computation. Considering this, the nodes are judiciously distributed via the sharding's partial reorganization technique to balance the processing capability of each shard, hence enhancing the system's overall performance and liveliness. According to simulation data, this sharding strategy successfully lowers the likelihood of a consensus failure, resolves the collusion attack issue brought on by the gathering of hostile nodes within shards, and lowers the blockchain system's latency. This offers solid proof of the blockchain sharding system's dependability and efficiency.

articleTitle: Indian Sign Language Classification Using Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: In recent years, there has been increased interest in the field of machine learning to develop accurate and efficient Indian Sign Language (ISL) classification models. This interest stems from the urgent need to overcome communication barriers and promote the inclusion of the hearing impaired. Here, ISL classification using transfer learning techniques with both a conventional convolutional neural network (CNN) and the powerful ResNet50 architecture has been used. Transfer learning has become a promising strategy in machine learning to enable models to be ready trained to adapt large datasets with limited labelled data to new tasks. The methodology involves fine-tuning models pre-trained on the ISL dataset using knowledge learned from different visual concepts. By exploiting the learned features of these deep learning architectures, this methodology can effectively capture the complex patterns and nuances of ISL gestures. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of transfer learning in ISL classification tasks. Both custom CNN and ResNet50 architectures achieve significant accuracy, which demonstrates the robustness and generalization of the transmitted data. These high accuracy rates highlight the potential of transfer learning as a valuable tool to solve the unique challenges of ISL classification. In addition, it is presented here as a user-friendly web-based application built with Stream lit to facilitate the smooth use of trained models. This application provides a practical platform for users to interact with the ISL classification system, enabling real-world applications and promoting accessibility for the hard of hearing.

articleTitle: Exploring Factors Influencing Energy Consumption Behavior Among Higher Education Students Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: This research examines the dynamics of university students’ energy usage behaviour using Internet of Things (IoT) technologies. The assignment meticulously positions a range of sensors in labs and lecture rooms and combines them with gadget learning algorithms to be able to maximize energy consumption. For a month, the Internet of Things sends actual-time notifications to students approximately the need for careful strength management. Before the implementation observations provide a comparative evaluation of student behavior and draw interest to the subtle behavioural adjustments as a result of psychological shifts. Machine studying fashions are built to forecast destiny energy use by way of using the information generated by way of those processes. These fashions include Decision Trees, Random Forests, Support Vector Machines, and Artificial Neural Networks. The consequences display a noteworthy decrease in strength use with the IoT machine in region, highlighting the significance of technological interventions in encouraging environmentally pleasant behaviour. From an academic angle, this advances our expertise of strength behaviour and gives useful information to educational establishments trying to find creative techniques to implementing responsible electricity control.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Malware Detection Techniques by using Predictive AI
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: In response to the ever-growing complexity and sophistication of cyber threats, organizations are increasingly turning to advanced technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI) to bolster their cybersecurity defenses. This major research paper delves into the development and implementation of AI-enabled Threat Intelligence (AI-TI) systems, with a focus on Random Forest, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and XGBoost. The research methodology encompasses a multifaceted approach, beginning with the collection and preprocessing of extensive datasets comprising internal network logs, security incident reports, and open-source threat intelligence feeds. These datasets serve as the foundation for training and evaluating the AI-TI systems powered by the selected algorithms. Through empirical experimentation and performance evaluation, the efficacy of each algorithm in detecting and mitigating cyber threats is rigorously assessed. Key performance metrics such as detection accuracy, false positive rates, and response times are analyzed to ascertain the optimal configuration and deployment strategy for AI-TI systems. By harnessing the capabilities of Random Forest, KNN, and XGBoost algorithms, organizations can enhance their cyber resilience and effectively combat the evolving threat landscape.

articleTitle: Swarm Based Searching Method for Effective Sinkhole Attack Detection in Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Over the last several decades, the IoT and WSN have seen a fast proliferation, which has resulted in astonishing innovation and integrated possibilities. Since the developments in networking technology and nanodevices, the transition from IPv4 to IPv6 has further increased connection. Due to this change, it becomes easier to connect a greater variety of devices to servers. The growing interconnectedness has resulted in challenges in effectively managing and evaluating the massively generated data across all levels of IoT. Considering the massive IoT devices and their tiny size, the demand of comprehensive security management is especially significant for these devices. In IoT layered design, the network layer is of utmost significance in terms of assuring security. This layer is responsible for storing routing information and carrying out choices that match to specific routing information. Among the several security assaults that are being handled, the sinkhole attack is one that is commonly observed and poses a considerable problem. In this study, the ramifications of the sinkhole attack on IoT are investigated in detail, and the effect of the attack is meticulously analyzed. In addition to this, it introduces a unique mitigation method that is specially built to effectively combat threats of this kind. To conduct comprehensive simulations, the study makes use of MATLAB v9. This has made it possible to evaluate the throughput of the network as well as the End-to-End delay and network lifetime.

articleTitle: A Smart Agent-based Online Shuttle Booking Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: City travelers rely heavily on online cab booking services for their daily transportation needs, making them an essential component of everyday commutes. Taxi businesses are seeing an increase in demand for integrated booking systems, which provide convenience for both parties. The centralized method used by many of the current online taxi booking systems to find, search for, and reserve taxis increases the danger of a single point of failure. In this paper, a mobile-driven cab-booking application named “FindUrShuttle” has been designed and deployed for real-time utilization. The developed application caters to a distributed taxi system based on intelligent agents that utilize local data. The NEXT.js, a React-based web framework, serves as the main backbone, providing the building blocks for the design and implementation of this application. Mapbox API has been incorporated into the application to find the shortest path between two points. In addition, vehicle pricing is dynamic and adjusted based on demand for vehicles. The simulation results of the developed application certainly demonstrate the effectiveness of a distributed booking system over centralized systems.

articleTitle: An IoT-Based Approach to Monitor the Health of Water Bodies Nearby Indian Villages
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: In 2018, 351 contaminated river segments in India were identified by the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB). Thirty-one provinces and the union territories (UT) have rivers and streams that failed to meet the criteria for the evaluation of water quality to identify polluted river lengths. to protect everyone's life on the planet. In recent years, a number of writers have put forth architectural-based solutions that emphasise increased efficiency and adaptability. New sensor capabilities are being created by improvements in sensor detection and communication. Water Quality Monitoring (WQM) is an economical and effective method that uses Internet of Things (IOT) technology to monitor the quality of water. These sensors were interfaced with a Microcontroller Unit (MCU), and additional processing was carried out on a Personal Computer (PC). An IOT-based ThingSpeak application is used to transmit the acquired data to the cloud in order to track the water quality. The accuracy of the prediction is increased with the proposed system, and the power of drawing conclusions is enhanced with IOT technology.

articleTitle: Detecting Propaganda During Article 370 Abrogation Using ML on Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Home Minister Amit Shah's move to abrogate Articles 370 and 35A had massive ramifications for Jammu and Kashmir (J&K). They express their thoughts on Facebook or Twitter, Twitter: It is also a huge playground for spreading misinformation and propaganda. This work employs machine learning with the objective of detecting propaganda during the J&K abrogation of Articles 370 and 35A. Data from Twitter was extracted using its API, leveraging trending hashtags. Subsequently, we manually annotated the results The work makes use of a hybrid-feature engineering method for feature selection, after which several machine learning algorithms are applied in order to classify the tweets into two categories. The decision tree algorithm yields superior results when comparing all the algorithms used. Deep learning can be applied to classification tasks, and the feature engineering approach can be enhanced for more precise outcomes.

articleTitle: Musical Brainwaves: Decoding Electroencephalography Signals Elicited by Musical Stimuli
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The influence of music on the human brain has been recognized for centuries, but recent advancements in brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) offer unparalleled opportunities to probe its complexities. This study investigates the effectiveness of music as a stimulus for driving BCIs using electroencephalography (EEG) signals. We analyze the neural correlates of music perception and imagination in the OpenMIIR dataset, employing advanced machine learning algorithms for EEG decoding. Exploiting various feature engineering techniques in time domain and frequency domain, we leverage convolutional neural networks and speech-inspired architectures like VLAAI to reconstruct the original audio stimuli from EEG data. Our results demonstrate a significant improvement in reconstructing music stimuli from EEG signals in the time domain, achieving a Pearson correlation of 0.35 compared to the current state-of-the-art performance of 0.11. Similarly, an increase in accuracy in classifying lyrical and non-lyrical musical excerpts based on participants' EEG responses was observed, rising from 49.6% to 57%.

articleTitle: Driver Behaviour Analysis to Improve Road Safety: A Comprehensive Study
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Road safety is a shared responsibility that includes following traffic regulations, using defensive driving methods, and prioritizing vehicle maintenance. Consistent alertness behind the wheel, following speed limits, and avoiding distractions like phone use are critical factors in avoiding avoidable road accidents. The number of road accidents, however, has not fallen considerably. Hence, there is a need for a comprehensive study to tackle this problem. This study introduces an innovative approach integrating driver support and infotainment systems to categorize drivers based on their skills and states. Utilizing a machine learning methodology, we classify drivers’ maneuvering skills by employing longitudinal and lateral controls, coupled with vehicle speed. This classification relies on a holistic model constructed from sensor data capturing the driving environment, driver behaviors, and vehicle responses. The developed model enables automatic classification of an unknown driver's safety level, providing a personalized approach to enhance road safety. In this paper, our focus shifts to assessing driving skills using results from a driving simulator, particularly in curve driving scenarios. Our methodology employed various machine learning algorithms to train the model, including K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Gradient Boosting, AdaBoost, and Random Forest classifiers. Among these, Random Forest exhibited the highest accuracy, achieving an impressive 83% classification accuracy in distinguishing between safe and aggressive drivers. This research contributes to the development of intelligent systems that not only enhance road safety and encourage conscientious driving behaviors but also personalize infotainment offerings, providing a comprehensive approach to driver satisfaction and safety)

articleTitle: Pioneering Seizure Prediction: Exploring ML and DL Approaches with IEEG Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Epilepsy is a neurological condition with the brain which makes people has sudden—uncontrolled shaking called seizures. Some people have epilepsy that even medicine cannot help. However, scientists are now interested in using Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) to predict when seizures will happen. This could help stop seizures before they start by using devices called neuro-stimulators. But the methods used before need lots of data from brain tests such as— Electroencephalograms (EEG). Getting this data is hard—and it might not show what really happens in real life. Therefore, this study looks at a lot of different ways to use ML and DL to predict seizures. We use data from inside the brain called Intracranial Electroencephalography (IEEG). We tries out many different models—including new ones that use graphs, to see which one works the best for predicting seizures. Unlike other studies—this one uses only a little bit of data to test the models. We show that ML could be really useful for predicting seizures. The results of these tests show how well each model works and give advice on how to deal with this important health problem.

articleTitle: Military Aircraft Surface Defect Detection Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach to automating aircraft surface inspection by leveraging deep learning techniques for the classification of thirteen different types of defects across the entirety of the aircraft exterior. Building upon existing research, which has primarily focused on specific areas of the aircraft, this study extends the scope to encompass comprehensive defect detection across the entire exterior surface. A dataset comprising labeled defect images, encompassing categories such as dents, scratches, radome damage, air intake damage, various types of rivet damage, and surface corrosion, was collected for training purposes. Google Vertex AI, an AutoML platform, was employed to train deep learning models for image classification of the 13 defect categories. Additionally, detailed literature review was conducted, exploring the utilization of deep learning models including YOLO, GAN, and CNN for detecting defects on aircraft surface. The results demonstrate the feasibility of fully automating aircraft inspection using either unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) or static cameras, based on the developed deep learning defect classification models. This improvement holds significant promise for enabling more frequent and detailed inspections, thereby enhancing aircraft safety and maintenance practices. The 13 defect categories cover a wide spectrum of potential issues, showcasing the versatility and effectiveness of the trained models.

articleTitle: A Multimodal Fusion Framework for Low Resource Game Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Ludo king (LK) is one of the most popularly downloaded games from Appstore and is regarded as low resource game. In this paper, we propose a novel framework to rate LK using multimodal features and ratings derived from user, expert and their fusion. The User feature grid comprises of 18 UX and 4 UI features and serves as input to collect ratings from 40 gamers whose response lies in {-1, 0, +1}. We scrape 9 expert reviews from reliably curated online sources and use these to formulate expert feature grid and ratings. We process user and expert feature grids for distinctive and common features to formulate fusion rating. The proposed Fusion approach is expected to overcome typical limitations such as class imbalance, limited sample size and poor quality samples in user reviews. Simulations on the proposed framework yield following performance related insights for LK: Average UI ratings: 0.14 for User features, 1 for Expert features and 0.80 for Overlap features; Average UX ratings: 0.29 for User features, 0.63 for Expert features and 0.63 for Overlap features; Effective ratings combining UI and UX: 0.26 for User features, 0.70 for Expert features and 0.68 for Overlap features; and finally, the rating is 0.44 for Fusion features. The proposed framework though demonstrated for LK can be made applicable for performance analysis of other e-commerce products.

articleTitle: Optimizing Machine Translation: A Benchmarking Suite for Efficiency and Quality Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: One of the core functions of Natural Language Processing (NLP) is machine translation—which is essential for bridging linguistic and cultural communication gaps. Nevertheless, computational expenses also increase with the size of huge language models. Libraries such as the high-performance inference engine—Archer—work to minimize the resources required to use these models' predictive power by optimizing their deployment. Therefore, creating a machine translation benchmarking suite is the main goal of this study in order to support such technologies. In terms of output quality and model execution efficiency, the suite is intended to help alleviate performance bottlenecks. The suite's design—which can be extended to accommodate more metrics, exemplifies a methodical approach to assessing machine translation models through ongoing modification. Moreover, the work done offer a building block to help design inference libraries to support the creation of serving Machine Learning (ML) models—as well as to benchmark the inference runtime of trained models. Lastly, sparse—larger models like Switch Transformer and No Language Left Behind (NLLB)- Mixture of Experts (MoE) deployed with Archer are examined utilizing the framework, as well as findings reported from dense models like T5 and NLLB. This study advances the fields of NLP and machine translation by enhancing the effectiveness of model execution and translation quality.

articleTitle: A Secure Peer to Peer Key Validation Protocol Using Symmetrical Group
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The robustness and consistency of cryptographic keys are essential components that determine the security for cryptographic systems. This study provides a thorough analysis of important authentication strategies and highlights their critical function in enhancing digital communication security and data security. We begin by elucidating the significance of key authentication as a critical component in safeguarding sensitive information. In an era marked by growing cyber threats, ensuring the authenticity and reliability of cryptographic keys is paramount. The paper provides a comprehensive survey of key authentication methods, ranging from traditional approaches like password-based authentication to advanced techniques such as biometrics, multifactor authentication, and hardware security modules. Each method is critically evaluated for its strengths, weaknesses, and suitability in diverse applications. Furthermore, this research explores practical implementations of key authentication in real-world scenarios. We investigate secure messaging protocols, data encryption, and access control systems, highlighting how key authentication strengthens security in these contexts. The evolving landscape of cryptography is also addressed, with insights into emerging trends like post-quantum cryptography and blockchain-based authentication. These innovations promise to reshape the future of key authentication and data security. This study emphasizes how important key authentication is to the field of cryptography. By advancing our understanding of these techniques and their practical applications, we contribute to fortifying the foundations of secure digital communication in an increasingly interconnected world.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Methodologies for Predicting Fake News on Social Media X: A Comparative Investigation Over TruthSeeker Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: In this era of social media, where every piece of information is at the user's fingertips, anyone who has smart devices and an internet connection can access or create a new piece of information online on these social media sites with just a single click. This changes the delivery of news and how people stay informed. These days, individuals can receive breaking reports on their preferred social media sites without relying on traditional news broadcasting methods. This changes the method by which news is accessed and communicated in the modern internet era. But with this new way of getting information from social media platforms comes the new challenge of determining the credibility and accuracy of the information shared. Most of the time, fake news without proper fact-finding and misinformation can spread quickly, causing confusion and distrust among the public. This kind of fraudulent story is perhaps the foremost risk to any government and may cause social unrest and instability. In this research, our goal is to analyze and predict fraudulent news identification over digital platforms, especially the ‘X’, also known as 'Twitter, to create a reliable and efficient system that can identify fake news in real-time with high accuracy using machine learning algorithms on the CIC's (Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity's) truth seeker database of 2023. The proposed system is able to recognize fraudulent information across social platforms with its highest 99.97<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> accuracy using LR and MLP machine learning algorithms, which is much higher as compared to the existing benchmark studies. Further, this proposed system helps to ensure the detection of bogus headlines over various digital media platforms with the highest accuracy, which minimizes the impact of misleading information and safeguards users from being deceived, which helps us to curb the spread of fraudulent breaking news and prevent potential harm to society.

articleTitle: Unified Approach Integrating Machine Learning Algorithms for Detection of e-Mail Phishing Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: With the ever-rising risk of phishing attacks, which capitalize on vulnerable human behavior in the contemporary digital space, requires new cybersecurity methods. This literary work contributes to the solution by novel incorporation of three techniques: Support Vector Machine (SVM), Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Random Forest (RF). Utilizing NLP for deep analysis of text in phishing e-mails, SVM for strong categorization and Random Forest's decision making by group helps in improving detection. This combination of language and pattern analysis along with group learning builds a fortified system. This approach differs from prior work on a variety of factors such as reliability, security, integrity, scalability, interpretability, transparency, and robustness. Thorough evaluation on a reliable dataset aimed to demonstrate the method's effectiveness, which resulted in 98.7 % of accuracy in detection. This majorly aims at showcasing the potential of ensemble techniques to combat against cyber-attacks like phishing for laying a strong foundation for a secure digital environment.

articleTitle: Iris Image Data Base Management Using Retinal Biometric Data for Security Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: IrisDB (Iris image Data Base) is an innovative database system presented in this work, designed to optimize the processes of retinal biometric data storage and retrieval. IrisDB effectively tackles the distinct obstacles presented by the substantial file size and high dimensionality of iris images through the incorporation of state-of-the-art indexing methodologies, optimal compression algorithms, and resilient encryption systems. To optimize storage utilization and facilitate retrieval operations, the system implements a hybrid compression method and a multi-tiered indexing mechanism. Critical data is further protected by AES-256 encryption. According to the testing outcomes, IrisDB is the optimal solution for large-scale biometric databases due to its substantial reduction in storage requirements and enhancement in retrieval times when compared to current systems. IrisDB competency in effectively managing enrollment and verification procedures is demonstrated through its thorough exposition of its architecture and workflow. Iris biometric data is utilized by numerous identification and security applications; the scalable and secure architecture of IrisDB has the capacity to fundamentally transform this procedure.

articleTitle: Load Balancing in Cloud Computing: Techniques, Challenges and Future Prospects
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Load balancing is a critical aspect of optimizing resource utilization and performance in cloud computing environments. This paper begins by introducing the fundamental concepts of load balancing and underscoring its significance in achieving scalability, efficiency, and user satisfaction within cloud ecosystems & presents a comprehensive exploration of load balancing techniques in cloud environment. The objectives of the paper are to unveil a spectrum of load balancing techniques, discuss challenges inherent to load distribution, and identify potential future prospects for this evolving field. A comparative analysis of the various approaches highlights their respective strengths and weaknesses, considering parameters like performance, scalability, and implementation complexity. With an extensive survey of the literature, this paper provides researchers and practitioners with a holistic perspective on load balancing in cloud computing.

articleTitle: Automated Network Topology Discovery and Secure Blockchain Storage via Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: An automated method has been created to discover network topology and safely store it on the blockchain via Machine Learning (ML). This utility consists of two separate modules. The first module implements a network topology inference algorithm—which uses cutting-edge approaches to infer network topology—even—when only partial information is provided. The second module focuses on blockchain integration—which uses a quick and energy-efficient consensus mechanism designed to securely store topology data. These two modules function separately but are intended to complement one another. The experimental results show that their combined functioning produces a precise reconstruction of network architecture that is resistant to tampering attempts. This dual-module technique ensures that network topologies are precisely mapped and securely stored—resulting in a robust solution for network management and security.

articleTitle: Deep Neural Networks for Diagnosis of Parkinson's Disease Using Replicated Acoustic Features
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Parkinson's disease is a neurodegenerative disease that affects a person's non-motor and motor functions causing tremors, stiffness, difficulty in moving, fatigue, anxiety, sleep disorders, etc. This condition happens because of the absence of dopamine-producing cells in the brain, and its symptoms worsen over time. This paper proposes a method for diagnosing Parkinson's disease using replicated acoustic features. This paper uses feature selection algorithms namely Fisher's, mRMR, Boruta, and ANOVA (Analysis of Variance) to find out the most discriminative features, and these features were fed into Random Forest (RF) and Deep neural networks (DNNs) to diagnose Parkinson's disease. 99.17% is the highest accuracy is achieved with the DNNs with Boruta and DNNs with ANOVA models. This is a significant improvement compared to previous studies. This result suggests that the replicated acoustic features can be used to diagnose Parkinson's disease.

articleTitle: An Analysis of AI-Driven Technologies for Enhancing Security along the India-Nepal Border
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Securing the border poses a substantial difficulty, especially in thwarting the illicit transportation of weapons, contraband, and drugs, and dealing with concerns like unlawful immigration and terrorist operations. Preserving legal commerce, financial well-being, and the autonomy of a nation is of utmost importance when it comes to international borders. This study examines an algorithm to develop a model capable of remotely detecting and categorizing humans. The model will be able to capture complete images of the person and their face separately. Additionally, it will perform a criminal record crosscheck using worldwide databases to forecast whether the person represents potential danger, is an aspiring migrant, terrorist, or fanatic. Subsequently, it notifies frontier authorities via an AI-driven computer system. The Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) and Armed Police Force (APF) have bases in Indo-Nepal respectively. Across their frontiers to tackle safety breaches, specifically targeting the management of activities that span borders that represent substantial dangers for the domestic & international protection of both nations. Thus, this study seeks to enhance peace and security by combating illicit trading, unlawful activities, and cross-border offenses between Indo-Nepal. This will be achieved by implementing an AI-powered computer surveillance network by security personnel stationed at the frontier. Therefore Indo-Nepal frontiers pose unique challenges due to their porous nature.

articleTitle: Energy Harvesting and Machine Learning Techniques for Internet of Things Applications: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The powerful platform that connects both the physical and digital realms is called the Internet of Things, or IoT. The standard of life has increased due to the current developments in Internet of Things (IoT) technologies, which have also enhanced human-technology engagement. The low expenses for positioning, remote availability, and intelligent operation of IoT nodes and sensors are the most important characteristics that propel the IoT's broad acceptance and rapid expansion in the ecological, health, and commercial domains. To solve the matter of energy shortages, energy harvesters, or EHs, are necessary for self-sustaining Internet of Things nodes. In this paper, an extensive analysis of machine learning (ML) techniques used in conjunction with EH-powered Internet of Things (IoT) devices to estimate and manage energy availability. The authors examined the machine learning techniques based on its applications, advantages and limitations on the basis of recent literature.

articleTitle: Neuroendocrine Tumor Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Advancements in machine learning have catalysed a transformative shift in healthcare, enabling the development of predictive models for early disease detection. This paper introduces a cutting-edge system, the Neuroendocrine Tumor Detection System (NETDS), which leverages machine learning to anticipate the presence of neuroendocrine tumors based on comprehensive data encompassing medical history with precision, lifestyle factors, and demographic information. NETDS represents a proactive approach to addressing the burgeoning challenges in healthcare by prioritizing early detection and prevention of neuroendocrine tumors. Key components of NETDS include meticulous data preprocessing, strategic feature selection, rigorous model training, and precise disease prognosis. While offering significant benefits such as early intervention and cost-effectiveness, ethical considerations pertaining to data privacy, model interpretability, and ongoing refinement are paramount for the responsible and effective deployment of NETDS in clinical settings. Consequently, NETDS holds immense promise for improving public health outcomes and mitigating the burdens associated with neuroendocrine tumors.

articleTitle: Dimension Reduction Techniques for Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Dimension-reduction techniques can be used to optimize a class problems. We investigate various dimensional reduction techniques to find the best method for our data processing. It is thoroughly discussed how features are extracted and selected. We discuss the various factors that must be considered when reducing dimensions in this paper. In the later part of this paper, we discuss in detail the basic techniques such as principal component analysis, kernel principal component analysis and auto encoder.

articleTitle: FireWatch: Advancing Forest Fire Detection Through Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Forest fires are so dangerous to ecosystems, people, and property, precise prediction models are essential for developing effective mitigation measures. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) constructed in TensorFlow are used in this to compare forest fire prediction models with the goal of evaluating their robustness, performance, and application in a variety of environmental settings. The paper uses TensorFlow, a popular deep learning framework, to investigate the design and implementation of CNN-based models for forest fire prediction. Variations in model depth, convolutional layers, pooling methods, and activation functions are taken into consideration while examining various CNN architectures and combinations. This comparative study includes both conventional CNN designs and new modifications designed for forest fire prediction applications. The use of input data sources, including as satellite imagery, meteorological data, topographical information, and historical fire records, is a crucial component of comparison. In order to improve the performance and generalization capacities of the model, many preprocessing methods for data augmentation, generalization, and feature extraction are assessed. The study also looks into how generalization methods, generalization algorithms, and hyper parameter tuning affect model convergence and forecast accuracy. The study also investigates the scalability and computing efficiency of CNN-based models for early warning systems and real-time forest fire prediction. There is additional discussion of model deployment considerations in situations with limited resources, including edge devices and remote sensing platforms.

articleTitle: Cutting-Edge Techniques for Enhanced Kidney Stone Detection in Ultrasound Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The identification of regions of interest (ROIs) in ultrasound images is a complex task due to the varied textures and inherent speckle noise of such images. Ultrasound scanning is widely utilized for diagnosing abnormalities, including kidney stones, where accurate detection is crucial. This research addresses the challenges associated with automatic object detection in ultrasound images, focusing on enhancing kidney stone recognition. An application has been developed to assist medical practitioners in pinpointing stone regions within ultrasound images through a semi-automatic approach. In this system, practitioners first select the regions of interest for analysis, followed by the application of feature extraction techniques to these selected areas. The techniques employed include Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE), Gabor filters, and Active Contour Models (ACMs). CLAHE improves image contrast and detail, Gabor filters capture texture information, and ACMs provide precise object delineation and segmentation. Experimental results demonstrate that the integration of these three methods offers a significant improvement in kidney stone detection compared to using each technique independently. The combined application of CLAHE, Gabor filters, and ACMs leverages the strengths of each method, resulting in enhanced accuracy and reliability in identifying stone regions. This approach aims to advance diagnostic precision and enable timely interventions for patients with kidney stones. Ongoing refinements and validations of this methodology are essential to further enhance its robustness and practical applicability in clinical settings, ultimately contributing to better patient outcomes.

articleTitle: AReview of Aspect Detection and Categorization Techniques for Text Summarization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The text summarization plays a pivot role to comprehend the large text in a meaningful manner to reduce the burden of going through the documents. The automatic and robust text summarization has several real-life applications such as News article summarization, Online meeting transcripts summarization etc. The text summarization can be done considering various features of the text. In this paper, we review the text summarization techniques focused on aspect detection and categorization. This study shows in depth analysis of different methods used for the aspect detection and categorization. Furthermore, this work employs selected methodologies to demonstrate practical applications, emphasizing their effectiveness in the context of producing logical and clear text summaries. The proposed work will help prospective researchers to understand the importance of aspects in text for summarization and it will also provide the knowledge on avenues of approaches used for summarization.

articleTitle: Multi-Species Classification of Malaria Parasites using Ensemble Transfer Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Malaria, a prevalent global health concern, necessitates accurate and prompt diagnosis for the treatment and control of disease. Microscopic examination of thin blood smear images is the definitive method for diagnosing Malaria. However, this method relies on skilled experts and is prone to human error. This paper introduces an innovative method for categorizing thin blood smear images of Plasmodium parasite species into their four types through an ensemble transfer learning technique. By utilizing the information gathered from pre-trained models on sizable datasets, our approach uses a deep learning framework built on transfer learning. A diverse ensemble of models, such as Xception, EfficientNet, MobileNet and DenseNet 121, was utilized to collectively capture intricate patterns and representative features of different Malaria parasite species. To develop and evaluate our method, we collected and preprocessed the MP-IDB dataset, which includes blood slide images of all four parasite types. The literature reveals that no research has explicitly focused on identifying and categorizing all four Plasmodium species in blood smear images. It signifies a gap in the current body of knowledge, emphasizing the need for comprehensive investigations in this specific domain.
