Through rigorous experimentation and evaluation, our proposed weighted ensemble transfer learning technique achieves an accuracy 98.9 in classifying Malaria parasite species into its four types. Our work contributes to advancing computer-aided diagnosis of Malaria, paving the way for more effective and efficient disease management strategies.

articleTitle: Secure MAC-Based Two Way Authentication System (MTWAS) for Data Communication in Internet of Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The Internet of Vehicles (IoV) is a rising area within the perspective of the Intelligent Transportation System (ITS) that has gained research emphasis in recent years. It enables the people involved in the network to make collaborative decisions. Huge-scale information monitoring, accumulating, and exchanging among automobiles, roadside units, and other intelligent components in the environment are all made possible by IoV, enabling dynamic and impromptu communication. Nevertheless, there are still many obstacles to overcome in terms of confidentiality and security for these IoV connections, making them more vulnerable to security breaches. The present research proposes an encrypted communication mechanism between automobiles and various other IoV smart components, along with a reliable and affordable Secure MAC -based Two Way Authentication System (MTWAS) in (/oV). Leveraging the BAN logic, we propose a strict verification of reliability and authenticity for the suggested (MTW AS) approach. The research culminates with both quantitative and qualitative assessments showing that the proposed approach outperforms than other recent state-of-the-art systems.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approaches in Virtual Biopsy: A Review of Recent Developments and Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: This review enhances the fact that the recent advancements in virtual biopsy have paved ways for many models to have an impact on the accuracy and the outcomes of treatments in the world of medical imaging and general pathology. The review further gathers findings from different studies which inherits AI-models, including CNNs and ensemble learning algorithms, across various medical disciplines including kidney biopsy, breast cancer diagnosis and prostate cancer characterization. Paper discusses the key roles of these AI techniques consisting of image analysis, segmentation, feature extraction, classification within whole slide images (WSIs), leading to precision and risk assessment. However, the strategies of transfer learning and model generalization have and added advantage on optimization. Moreover, the patient care and individual treatment advantage have come in the scene with the concept of personalized medicine. It was concluded that how fusion of AI in virtual biopsy is revolutionizing the medical procedures and the sense of individualistic healthcare.

articleTitle: Astonishing Concept of Decentralized System and Its Integrity With Data: It's Existence In Concept Of “Block Chain” As Well As In Concept Of “Selfish Genes”
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: This research paper examines and study the intersections of the block chain technology and Richard Dawkin's Theory i.e. “selfish gene”. This research provides the detailed analysis based on the research of “Blockchain Technology and the Selfish Gene: A Conceptual Analysis” by Zittel et al. Paper emphasizes on “decentralized mechanism”, it shows similarities between selfish gene and Block chain by describing common traits of decentralized mechanism. Importance of accurate and correct data propagation is explained in both Domain (i.e. selfish gene and block chain). Analysis is done on natural selection and perpetuated correct data while eliminating inaccuracies, for explaining how only correct and accurate data can propagate in both concepts. This research also delves into mathematical models of data of both (i.e. selfish gene and block chain), and also finds similarities between them.

articleTitle: Natural Language Processing and Machine Learning Based Automated Diagnosis of Epilepsy in Electronic Health Record
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: To promptly obtain an accurate diagnosis to effectively manage and treat epilepsy. This research introduces a novel method for automating the epilepsy diagnostic process in EHRs using Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Machine Learning (ML). Therefore, natural language processing (NLP) techniques may be employed to extract medically relevant information from both structured data contained in electronic health records (EHRs) and unstructured clinical notes. Next, machine learning techniques will be employed to predict the presence or absence of epilepsy. The approach's high overall accuracy, specificity, and sensitivity, as assessed on a comprehensive dataset, make it a promising candidate for clinical applications. This diagnostic automation strategy is designed to achieve a more precise diagnosis, reduced anxiety for physicians, and improved health outcomes for patients. The results illustrate the practicality and utility of incorporating advanced data analysis techniques into clinical procedures, and the technology shows potential for the detection of neurological disorders such as epilepsy.

articleTitle: Minefield Evacuation Proximity Drift Safety Alert
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Safety is a critical concern in all industries, especially in mining, where the workforce's well-being is paramount. Mining operations' unique and hazardous conditions present significant real-time monitoring and data collection challenges. This paper introduces a comprehensive safety monitoring system designed specifically for coal mines, leveraging various advanced technologies to enhance safety. The system uses the Arduino Mega 2560 Rev3 as the central processing unit and NRF24L0l modules for robust wireless communication. It employs the u-blox NEO-MSN GPS module for precise location tracking of miners and the Haversine formula to determine the shortest distance considering the positions of two locations on the Earth's surface using their latitudes and longitudes. For high-speed, low-power wireless connectivity, the ESP32 module is integrated, ensuring secure data transfer. Environmental monitoring is conducted using fume analyzers to perceive varying levels of aerosol and solid-state emission detectors to monitor concentrations of toxic vapors, including sulfurous gas (SO2), nitrogen dioxide (NO2), and carbonous gas (CO), and Monoxide of carbon (CO). If any combustion monitors detects levels exceeding the secure perimeter, the microcontroller triggers a warning to notify personnel immediately. Additionally, the system features a sophisticated control panel for comprehensive result analysis and real-time monitoring of environmental conditions. This integrated approach ensures a safer working environment in coal mines by addressing the critical need for immediate attention to air quality and miner safety.

articleTitle: Enhanced Lung Cancer Detection Using CNNs for Accurate and Efficient CT Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Lung cancer must be detected as early as possible, but it may be difficult with existing methods since they often depend on human judgment and outdated image processing. These techniques take a lot of time and are prone to errors, which produces uneven outcomes. The research provides a unique deep learning-based method for classifying lung nodules from CT images using convolutional neural networks (CNNs). By automating feature extraction and categorization, the suggested technique greatly increases diagnostic precision. The result shows superior performance over existing systems is demonstrated by evaluation measures such as AUC-ROC, accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity. With a training duration of 12 hours, an AUC-ROC of 0.95, accuracy of 92%, sensitivity of 94%, specificity of 90%, and inference speed of 0.5 seconds per scan, the results demonstrate notable improvements in diagnostic efficiency and accuracy. Deep learning has the potential to revolutionize the diagnosis of lung cancer and enhance patient care, as demonstrated by the study.

articleTitle: Decoding the Mirage: A Comprehensive Review of DeepFake AI in Image and Video Manipulation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The evolution of deepfake development technology has increased the development of highly realistic digital media content. Nowadays, this technology is being used to manipulate photos and videos of influential personalities such as celebrities, politicians, or businessmen to either harm their reputation or spread false information. Although deepfake AI has both positive and negative application, this technology is mostly used with malicious intent such as to spread misinformation, engage in digital harassment, and undermine societal trust. This review paper provides a comprehensive examination of the available deepfake generation and detection methods, exploring both the opportunities and challenges presented by this emerging innovation. Detection methodologies based on deep learning and conventional methods as well the threats this emerging technology poses on the society are also surveyed. Overall, this review gives various insights of both generation and detection of deepfakes, combining its applications, approaches and future work.

articleTitle: Exploring the Cutting Edge Technology in Healthcare: A Comprehensive Review of Cloud Based Electronic Health Records
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Electronic health record (EHR) systems significantly save healthcare expenses by improving disease management and minimizing medical mistakes. However, existing systems do not effectively motivate most individuals to share their health information. Blockchain is a dependable alternative among the available choices for enhancing existing systems. There needs to be more knowledge on the impact of blockchain-based health information systems on patients' willingness to exchange their health data throughout healthcare networks. The Electronic Health Record encompasses many patients' data, making locating the most relevant information challenging and time-consuming. Precise and automated summarization and visualization techniques can enhance patient safety, optimize efficiency, facilitate clinical decision-making, and mitigate medical errors and costs. Interoperability and standardization are crucial for enhancing the quality-of-care services and effectively coordinating care and summarization practices. In this paper, the authors present the concept of Patient-Controlled Blockchain Enabled Electronic Health Records as a means for patients to securely manage their data in a decentralized, unchangeable, visible, traceable, and reliable manner. This strategy ensures that the data sent and stored in the cloud is secure, trustworthy, confidential, intact, authenticated, available, and easily controlled by the user.

articleTitle: ANPRSmaC: An Automatic Number Plate Recognizer for Intelligent Transportation in Smart City
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: In recent years, automatic vehicle number plate recognition using stationary cameras are gaining attention due to its various real-life applications such as automatic toll collection, automatic parking system, controlled access in premises, and traffic violations. In past, several approaches for automatic number plate recognition is proposed using conventional methods, machine learning, and more recently using the deep learning. In this paper, we propose an automatic number plate recognizer (ANPRSmaC) to faciliate the intelligent transportation in the smart city. The ANPRSmaC is primarily comprised of four stages such as car detection, number plate localization, character segmentation, and character recognition. In ANPRSmaC, the car detection and number plate localization is accomplished using the YoLo V8 pre-trained model. On the contrary, the we trained a CNN model for the character recognition. The ANPRSmac has used YoLo V5, YoLoV8, and Faster-RCNN to validate the efficiency of the models. The YoLo V5, YoLoV8, and Faster-RCNN have resulted in accuracy of 0.87, 0.994, and 0.992, respectively.

articleTitle: Smart Agriculture Inventory Management System Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: In the agricultural sector, smallholder farmers in India face significant challenges with post-harvest losses, fluctuating market prices, and unsustainable practices. This research proposes a mobile-based application designed specifically for farmers in region of India, focusing on specific crops. To reduce agricultural waste, the app features an optimal storage location based on crop type. To improve farmer income, the app includes a crop recommendation module that integrates historical yield data, weather forecasts, soil characteristics, and real-time market prices. Machine learning models, validated with field data, suggest high-yield, profitable crops and optimal sales timing. A market information hub provides real-time mandi prices and demand forecasts. With a user-friendly interface and visual explanations, the app addresses the technological constraints of smallholder farmers. This research aims to reduce agricultural waste, improve farmer income, and promote sustainable agriculture practices.

articleTitle: Intelligent Monitoring System of Two-Wheelers for Enforcing Helmet Regulations on Road
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Innovative method to enhance the road safety by detecting of helmet presence and identification of vehicle number plates among scooter and motorcycle riders is presented in this research work. The proposed approach integrates You-only-look-once (YOLO) -V9 for real-time detection of helmets and number plates, with Tesseract Optical-Character-Recognition (OCR) stepping in to extract number plate text if a rider is detected without a helmet. Captured data, including image coordinates and timestamps, are stored for future recognition in a database. Moreover, the proposed model is tested under different harsh weather conditions, such as fog, rain, and dust, establishing vigorous performance even in demanding scenarios and getting a good accuracy of 87%. This system is considered to strengthen compliance with helmet rules and assist enhanced enforcing of traffic laws. Primary trials display encouraging outcomes in accurately discriminating helmet usage and number plates, thus progresses the development of automated traffic surveillance systems.

articleTitle: A Novel Hybrid Approach for Threat Detection in Cyber Security using AI algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The dynamic cyber-attack landscape might require more traditional ways of detecting and preventing threats. It has also paved the way for new hybrid approaches that merge attributes of two or more different methods, enabling a better and more efficient cyber defence. Such an approach would be to apply artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms to detect threats. In this way, organizations can apply various capabilities to automatically scan network traffic round-the-clock for indicators of suspicious activities, notifying security teams immediately. Despite this, a system that relies entirely on AI algorithms gets many false positives, increasing the time and effort required by security personnel. Our hybrid approach includes human expertise and input to help detect potential risks. This comes as a human-in-the-loop solution, where AI algorithms identify suspicious signals, and humans then corroborate those leads before making an arrest. Combining human and AI intelligence results in a far more accurate and efficient threat detection system. Our strategy incorporates big data analytics and anomaly detection methods to highlight unusual behaviours that suggest a risk is forming. This allows our system to discover and eliminate these cyber attacks in real-time instead of merely reacting after a breach. By leveraging our novel hybrid approach, you can have better coverage and a more robust cyber security plan in the face of threats, giving you a higher level of protection and peace of mind about future attacks.

articleTitle: A Trust-Based Framework for Enhancing Security and Reliability in Vehicular Ad-hoc Networks (VANETs)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Vehicular Ad-hoc Networks (VANETs) are considered one of the key enablers for intelligent transportation systems and enable vehicle-to-vehicle or vehicles-infrastructure communications, that improve road safety; traffic management efficiency; and passenger comfort. Despite all their advantages, VANETs are strongly vulnerable to many security threats like data tampering, identity spoofing, and denial-of-service attacks that could threaten the dependability of such networks. In this paper, we present a trust-based framework to enhance the security and dependability in VANETs. The framework uses trust evaluation mechanisms to evaluate the authenticity of participating nodes and thus provably guarantees communication under adversaries. We proposed an approach that combines direct trust and indirect trust, where the former is based on past interactions among nodes while the latter are recommendations from neighboring within the network. In this way, we enhance security by using cryptographic techniques and a decentralized trust management system to eliminate single points of failure and build scalability. Simulation results show that the proposed trust framework can detect and isolate malicious nodes more efficiently and increase true positive rate at less cost of false positives while keeping the network reliable even in hostile conditions. This framework is not only secure but it also provides core communications needed for success in deploying of intelligent transportation systems, which has been overseen throughout real field-testing. This work helps in the ongoing quest of robust and secure environment for VANETs, making roads safer thereby more efficient.

articleTitle: Enhancing User Anonymity in IoT Blockchain: Machine Learning Deanonymization Risks and Mitigations
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: In the context of Internet of Things (IoT) and smart grids—this research studies the anonymity of blockchain users— with a particular emphasis on Machine Learning (ML) techniques for user de-anonymization. Blockchain data is eternal—yet user privacy is still sensitive. While concerns about anonymity are addressed by existing research—more study is required for IoT and smart grids. Therefore, this study highlights long-term anonymity threats owing to permanent data by analyzing blockchain transactions and off-chain sun exposure data to evaluate ML's efficacy in identifying smart grid blockchain users. The process includes gathering data from the power grid, creating blockchain ledgers, and using ML on historical transactions to identify households. In order to improve privacy—it assesses the value of including off-chain solar data and evaluates ledger obfuscation and public key techniques. As demonstrated by the data, ML models are able to reliably link user transactions. Using a convolutional network—peak classification accuracy was 84% for customer ID and 63% for postcode. Attacker success rates are increased when solar exposure data is included. Household energy consumption and solar generation are 85% accurately reconstructed by regression models. Public keys drastically lower attack success—with customer ID and postcode having the lowest classification accuracy drops to 4% and 11%, respectively.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Multi-Layer Algorithm for the Detection and Prevention of Security Issues in P2P Cloud Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Cloud security has an emerging trivial role to protect data hooked up with the applications in the domain of Cloud computing technology. The growing usage of cloud services has increased many folds dramatically in a few years. Cloud Architecture offers various services and models based on user requirements but the security of critical data is still a challenge for the cloud service provider. However, peer-to-peer networks provide an alternative to the conventional client-server computer model since they are decentralized, self-organized, and dynamic in their purest form. People can connect to a server using the client-server architecture, however despite servers' scalability, their capabilities are limited. P2P networks can scale to virtually infinite sizes. However, P2P network security issues (such as data leakage or disclosure, data corruption or loss, and user privacy breach) need to be thoroughly examined because there is no centralized authority and there are many attacks as a result. However, P2P can share the sensitive information that needs to be protected from manipulation, unlawful use, and unauthorized access. This makes data security one of the major concerns for P2P architectures. The paper proposed a security algorithm for a P2P cloud network with improved security. Moreover, we have designed a model for secure Authentication and tested it against various attacks using an Identity-Based model (ID), Authorization using a trust-based, and data storage using Fuzzy Cryptosystems. This framework allows only the P2P cloud client to share or access the data for ensuring data security and privacy. Thus, a P2P cloud system is to be developed with robust security and data reliability to provide high-quality service. Further, the paper discusses security and privacy issues in cloud computing mainly focusing on P2P cloud networks where security is still immature and challenging.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Privacy Attacks in Supervised Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: With the widespread integration of machine learning (ML) into diverse applications, it has become paramount to scrutinize its implications for security and privacy. Despite the burgeoning body of work in privacy, there is a noticeable gap in research attention between the security and privacy aspects of ML, specifically supervised machine learning (S-ML). This paper bridges this gap by analyzing research papers focusing on privacy attacks against S-ML over the past years. This study offers a comprehensive overview of prevalent defense mechanisms and initiates a thoughtful discussion on unresolved challenges and prospective research directions. As ML continues to permeate various domains, the scientific community's interest has expanded beyond performance metrics to encompass broader concerns such as security, privacy, fairness, and explainability. This survey investigates state-of-the-art privacy-related attacks, elucidating common design patterns and distinctive characteristics. Through this exploration, we identify several open problems that demand further investigation, emphasizing the critical need to fortify privacy frameworks alongside the escalating ubiquity of ML technologies.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Multi-Criteria Recommender System: Leveraging Autoencoders for Improved Personalization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Multi-Criteria Recommender Systems (MCRSs) are a promising method that takes into account several elements of the user's preferences in order to improve recommendation accuracy. However, most existing research has focused on single-criterion ratings, overlooking the potential of multi-criteria considerations in deep learning-based recommender systems. This paper introduces a novel deep learning-based algorithm for MCRSs, leveraging deep autoencoders to uncover complex user-item interactions based on multi-criteria preferences. The proposed algorithm, evaluated using the TripAdvisor multi-criteria dataset, demonstrates superior recommendation capabilities compared to traditional methods, achieving a significantly lower RMSE of 0.975. The results highlight the algorithm's effectiveness in providing accurate and personalized recommendations tailored to diverse user preferences, marking a significant advancement in MCRS performance.

articleTitle: Automated Personalized Mood-Based Song Selector
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Music and weather significantly influence individuals’ moods, playing pivotal roles in daily life. This research explores integrating music and weather data to enhance the driving experience by dynamically adjusting the music playlist based on the driver's mood and the current weather conditions, considering the potential hazards of manual song selection while driving. The research addresses the challenge of maintaining a consistent mood during long drives, which can be significantly influenced by the music played. We propose a solution that involves an AI-integrated application utilizing facial emotion recognition to gauge the driver's mood and weather data to infer the appropriate mood for the music. This mood detection system aims to select songs matching the combined mood, enhancing the overall driving experience. We employ machine learning models for emotion detection from facial expressions and weather data, employing binary and multiclass classification techniques. The study contributes to personalized music recommendation systems by introducing a novel approach that considers external environmental factors, demonstrating the potential for further advancements in mood-based music recommendation systems.

articleTitle: An IoT-Based Approach to Measure the Effectiveness of Traditionally Prepared Compost in Indian Villages
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The Smart Compost Monitoring system helps to monitor and check the compost made by the amateur or low knowledgeable farmers and enthusiasts and an ideal ratio achievement is the subject of the current invention, The innovation is built on using several sensors to monitor and track record for the required amount of nutrition as well as the compulsory elements for acquiring an ideal compost the invention is not only limited to the Rural Areas it can be deployed to the Urban areas as well. The suggested technology will use a special machine learning algorithm to take the readings from the compost and compare it with the previously fetched ideal ratios and provide the difference that is to be then fulfilled by the farmer. Every crop with different requirements will have selected predefined ratios to be reached and monitored and different prerequisites will be achieved before fully deploying the system. Furthermore, the paper can be a precise assessment of crucial parameters such as the carbon-tonitrogen (C/N) ratio and pH levels, ensuring accuracy in composting endeavours. The proposed architecture not only promises immediate assistance to those in need of natural compost but also eliminates the necessity for users to meticulously maintain nutritional levels during the composting process. By alerting users of any incompatible manure with their intended crops and confirming when optimal levels are achieved, the system offers comprehensive support throughout the composting journey. IoT enables us to have a Arduino unit directly installed in soil range of the crop land and by using the combined the range definitions of different sensors we are able to record the metrics of the sensors and then compare those with the predefined ones.

Author Keywords: Compost Monitoring, Internet of Things, Metric, Sensors

articleTitle: Clicks, Retweets, and Replies: A Data-Driven Exploration of what Makes News Go Viral
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The ever-growing volume of online news articles necessitates efficient methods to understand audience preferences. In this study Within pre-existing news article categories, the application of machine learning algorithms for forecasting news item popularity is analysed. K-Nearest Neighbors, Random Forest, and Support Vector Machine were used to categorize articles according to their level of popularity. The most pertinent features for prediction within each cluster were found using feature selection techniques. Based on the findings, all three algorithms produced results with encouraging accuracy, with K Nearest Neighbor and Support Vector Machine showing the best overall performance. For some clusters, popularity prediction is still difficult, indicating the need for more research into those groups’ characteristics. This research demonstrates how machine learning could be used to forecast news popularity within article clusters. News organizations can better engage their audience by customizing content creation and dissemination strategies based on their understanding of what makes articles popular within particular categories.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Model for Weather Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Weather forecasting predicts atmospheric conditions at a particular time and place. It is an important task with a wide range of applications, including agriculture, transportation, and disaster prevention. Traditional weather forecasting methods rely on physical models of the atmosphere, which can be complex and computationally expensive. In recent years, deep learning techniques are effective for weather forecasting. Deep learning models can learn complex patterns from data, which can be used to predict future weather conditions accurately. This project aims to create a deep-learning model for forecasting weather. A huge dataset of historical meteorological data, including radar, satellite, and surface measurements, will be used to train the model. Numerous meteorological factors, such as temperature, precipitation, and wind speed, will be predicted by the model. We will compare the deep learning model's performance with conventional weather forecasting techniques. Creating a deep learning model that is more accurate and effective than current approaches is the project's main objective. The initiative may result in improved weather forecasts that are prompt and accurate, better agricultural, transportation, and disaster prevention decision-making, and less money lost because of weather-related incidents. Possible obstacles for the project are gathering and purifying a sizable dataset of meteorological data, using this data to train a deep learning model, and then comparing the model's output with more conventional techniques.

articleTitle: Enhancing GPS Data Accuracy in SAP Systems Using IMU Sensors and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The Strava platform received 6.6 billion miles' worth of activity data in 2018. If consumers want to get fitter faster than their peers or professional athletes—they need accurate data. However, because Global Positioning System (GPS) data is noisy and low-frequency—users are sometimes frustrated by false paths—that suggest—they have ridden across lakes or sprinted through buildings. Therefore, this study uses sensors, such as accelerometers, gyroscopes, and magnetometers—found in an Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) to address this issue. We look into how to counteract the drift of high-frequency IMU sensors over time and low-frequency GPS sensors. Real-time correction during the activity—which necessitates computational efficiency, and post-activity correction—which permits the utilization of previous and upcoming measurements—are the two use cases that are examined. For these use cases, two approaches are used— Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), a recent technology, and the Kalman Filter, a traditional technique from the 1960s. The Kalman Filter can do a reverse pass post-activity for more accurate estimations by combining sensor values with historical positions. Without requiring specific sensor variance information, RNNs—such as Gated Recurrent Units and Long Short Term Memory Networks—use built-in memory modules to find patterns in sensor data. RNNs outperformed the Kalman filter in producing qualitatively credible findings, according to both approaches. However, inconsistent ground truth data made quantitative evaluation difficult. Prospective investigations are suggested to address these constraints.

articleTitle: Smart Attendance System Using Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The primary aim of this endeavor is to elevate the attendance management system employed in educational institutions through the introduction of an advanced smart attendance system leveraging facial recognition technology. In this work, we propose the development and implementation of a face detection and recognition system that will recognize students' faces to identify them automatically during a classroom lecture. The current system is beset by issues related to accuracy and efficiency. We have used the LBPH algorithm to design the attendance system. By incorporating facial recognition capabilities, the new system will establish databases of facial profiles, compare them during attendance sessions, and seamlessly update an Excel sheet with attendance records. To ensure a meticulous tracking process, the compiled daily attendance data will be transmitted via email to the respective faculty members. The utilization of facial recognition technology in attendance management represents a method of identifying students based on facial biometrics, drawing upon sophisticated monitoring and computer technologies.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Exploration of AI Based Approaches for Enhancing Security and Routing in VANET
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: An example of a non-infrastructure system is a vehicle ad hoc network (VANET). Vehicle data sharing for traffic analysis and security is made possible by the network. This network's information transmission is time-sensitive, necessitating a solid and quick network connection. Because to its wireless ad hoc structure, VANET satisfies this criteria, regardless security issues. This network's most vibrant connections, sensitive info exchange, and time-bound nature makes it an appealing target for attackers. The study here describes the VANET literature survey, with a focus on vulnerabilities and the challenges associated with them. Paper discusses VANET layout, safety ethics, attack aspects, and characteristics of likely VANET attacks, as well as some remedies based on swarm based optimization techniques and machine learning for secure and energy effective routing. Paper also compares the results of some state of art work done and it has been found that selection of appropriate machine learning technique and optimization approach are crucial to VANETS security and efficient routing. In summary, this paper thoroughly investigates the VANET system as a whole as well as its applications along with analysis of potential remedies and security measures for guaranteeing safe and effective communication in VANETs.

articleTitle: Developing an Adaptive Educational Chatbot for Personalized SQL Tutoring
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Today chatbots are the most popular assistant tool we come across while surfing any website, browser, application. Chatbots are multi-functional interactive computer programs that can help a user to do a task or chat by using the natural language dialogue. The use of these bots is made for many purposes by the users-including the education. Therefore, this study purposed an educational chatbot for the purpose of tutoring students in the natural language by acting as a human-like teaching assistant. This bot may provide great help to a student in carrying out their exercise, solving problems and modifying the learning pace to meet the requirements of every student separately. Structured Query Language (SQL) was given to students as per their capabilities and customized solutions to their problems. For the purpose of this study-the Rasa Open-Source Framework was utilized to test the framework. Two chatbots were tested-one with the trained model with RASA suggested pipeline and the other trained in the Spacy pre-trained model. The study reflected that these models produced results with similar accuracy, response-time, F -1 score, and precision. However, the chatbots of SQL which are trained with the RASA recommended pipeline resulted in performing better with a 0.01171 p-value in the intent classification.

articleTitle: Privacy Preserving Electronic Health Records Sharing using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: A variety of fundamental challenges, such as a lack of data transparency, traceability, immutability, audit, data provenance, flexible access, trust, privacy, and security, confront healthcare information management systems today. Furthermore, the centralized nature of most existing healthcare systems for data management raises the risk of a single point of failure in the event of a natural disaster. Blockchain, a novel and disruptive type of decentralized technology, has the potential to profoundly revolutionize, reshape, and transform the way the healthcare sector manages data. This could have a significant impact on the quality of care that patients receive. We have covered the fundamental capacities and characteristics of blockchain technology that are required to ensure the safety of patient data. We investigate the most significant benefits of utilizing blockchain technology and its potential applications in the medical and healthcare industries. The field of medicine has witnessed a surge in interest in mobile applications, particularly those aimed at patients. However, there are several concerns regarding privacy and safety with the current mechanisms for sharing data from IoT devices and medical records. These concerns relate to the fact that these mechanisms are currently in use. The electronic health record proposes the blockchain technology and the Inter Planetary File System (IPFS) mechanism, both of which are secure and considerate of patients' privacy, to effectively tackle these concerns. In conclusion, we cover a broad spectrum of potential research topics for further investigation.

articleTitle: Exploring Climate Change Prediction Dynamics Using Machine Learning Approach: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Climate refers to the long-term weather patterns of a region. Variations in the weather have a lot of implications on our daily lives. Explore the application of deep learning techniques in climate prediction and related fields. It focuses on Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models for forecasting air quality, greenhouse temperature control, and urban flood water accumulation using Gradient Boosted Decision Trees (GBDT). The analysis concludes that deep learning, particularly LSTM, offers promising accuracy for various climate-related predictions. Challenges such as data scarcity, non-stationarity, and high dimensionality are addressed, highlighting the need for advanced models to capture complex climate system dynamics and human influences.

articleTitle: Managing Cybersecurity Challenges on a Global Scale: Balancing Foreign Policy Priorities with the Rise of Digital Threats
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: This study represents an innovative examination of the potential intersections between Foreign Policy and Cyber Attacks. In today's rapidly evolving landscape, there has been a noticeable uptick in cyber assaults originating from both non-state and state entities. Nations are actively bolstering their cyber defences to safeguard their data sovereignty. Simultaneously, countries are augmenting their capabilities for both offensive and defensive cyber operations. This research delves into the alignment between a state's strategic vision and its employment of Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) groups to further its objectives in the cybersecurity realm. The authors seek to unravel the complexities of achieving Foreign Policy goals through cyber warfare, a nuanced tool that holds the potential to significantly impact nations. This study examines specific countries and their methods of achieving strategic aims through cyber warfare and also proposes a framework for analysing the future probability of attacks using a novel framework built by the authors using Natural Language Processing.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based System for Abnormality Detection and Classification in MRI with Advanced Techniques for Brain Tumor Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: A brain tumor refers to an irregular proliferation of nerve cells in the human brain, disrupting its typical functioning. It has resulted in the loss of many lives. To rescue patients suffering from this condition, it is critical to discover it early and treat it properly. Identifying tumor-impacted cells in the brains of humans is a laborious and lengthy procedure. Nevertheless, the precision and time necessary for identifying tumors in the human brain provide a substantial hurdle in the arena of image investigations. This study designs and implements a brain tumor detection system by employing machine learning technique-Support Vector Machine and considering Magnetic Resonance Imaging brain images. The devised detection system serves multiple functionalities, which involves compilation of input data, pre-processing steps (encompassing k-means clustering for image segmentation endeavors), Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) method-driven extraction of feature, SVM application, image classification, Convolutional Neural Network-based abnormality classification, Additionally, we propose treatment strategies for the three types of tumors: glioma, meningioma, and pituitary tumors. Our CNN-based framework for identifying brain abnormalities is currently being evaluated for its performance through accuracy metrics and confusion matrices, supplemented by simulation visuals. This thorough methodology aims to enhance the precision and dependability of brain tumor detection, while also offering valuable insights into customized treatment approaches tailored to the specific tumor types identified.

articleTitle: Real-Time Hospital Noise Detection and Classification Using IoT Devices, MFCC, and Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Hospital noise is a critical issue affecting patient well-being and healthcare outcomes. In this paper, we propose an innovative system for hospital noise detection and segregation leveraging Internet of Things (IoT) technology, Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCC), and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN). Our approach involves deploying IoT devices equipped with microphones in hospital environments to continuously capture audio data. Pre-processing techniques are applied to the collected audio sam ples to remove noise and normalize signals. MFCC features are then extracted from the pre-processed data to capture unique sound characteristics. These features serve as inputs to a supervised ANN model trained to classify noise into hospital and non-hospital categories. The performance of the model is evalu ated using a validation dataset, and upon achieving satisfactory results, the model is deployed in the IoT infrastructure for real-time noise analysis. Con tinuous monitor- ing and periodic fine-tuning ensure adaptability to evolving noise patterns.

articleTitle: AI-ML Innovations in Forest Fire Detection: Protecting Ecosystems and Communities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: Forest fires facing a huge danger to environments, flora as well as fauna, and mankind, underscoring the need for rapid and correct detection methods. Proposed research represents an state-of-the-art technique to proactive identification and mitigation of forest fires by customizing the techniques in the Machine Learning as well as Artificial Intelligence. The proposed system leverages a community of faraway sensors strategically positioned throughout the forested region. Attached sensors continuously records the diverse ecological parameters inclusive of temperature, wind speed, clamminess and smoke patterns. When the input collected from such data capturing sensors are transmitted to a relevant AIdriven machine, the middle of the system is an ensemble of ML models that analyze the incoming sensor data in actual-time. The fashions are skilled to understand patterns related to the early stages of a wooded area fireplace. By employing strategies including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Random Forests, the gadget can rapidly differentiate among normal environmental fluctuations and potential fire signs. Upon detecting extraordinary styles that characterize a ability fireplace outbreak, the device triggers an instantaneous response. This reaction consists of alerting applicable authorities, which include neighborhood firefighting teams and wooded area management agencies, and supplying actual-time updates on the fire's development. The system's accuracy and reliability are achieved thru continuous getting to know and refinement. As it tactics more statistics over the years, the AI models adapt and enhance their ability to distinguish between false alarms and real fireplace threats. The proposed AI and ML-based totally early detection gadget affords a gifted way to moderate the devastating pressure of forest fires. By unexpectedly figuring out capability fireplace outbreaks, it permits timely and focused interventions, thereby safeguarding our natural sources and groups.

articleTitle: Methods and Applications for Sentiment Analysis in Online Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: With hyped popularity of social media, sentiment analysis, a branch of natural language processing (NLP), has gained significant attention. Social media is a treasure trove for gaining insights into the thoughts, feelings, and opinions of the general public due to the abundance of user-generated content. This work offers a thorough review of sentiment analysis applied in social media, covering its methods, applications, and challenges. It discusses various approaches to sentiment analysis, from deep learning and machine learning models to rule-based techniques. Additionally, it examines the challenges associated with sentiment analysis of social media content, such as context dependence, slang, and sarcasm. The study also explores the various applications of sentiment analysis in social media, including tracking public opinion, political sentiment analysis, customer feedback analysis, and brand monitoring. By exploring these facets, this work seeks to throw light on the current state of the art in social media sentiment analysis and its implications.

articleTitle: Analytical Approach Towards Radiological Image-based Fracture Assessment Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The utilization of Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques has been prevalent in various applications and the gradual increase in implementation towards healthcare sectors has scaled up. Computer aided diagnosis has emerged as a major research area directed toward efficient use of resources. Fracture of bone has been a popular health problem associated with risk for mortality. Fractures are frequent in the long bones or the weight-bearing bones. AI techniques to accurately detect and classify fractures are still a challenging task beyond the conventional methods. Our objective is to assess the effectiveness of multiple algorithms in identifying and categorizing ankle fractures using radiological images. This review paper focuses on several available approaches of Deep-Learning (DL) and Machine-Learning (ML) regarding Ankle Fracture Classification and Identification based on Radiological Images for Medical Applications. The goal is to assist physicians and orthopaedics with simple and realistic decision support systems. In addition to a comprehensive analysis of the research, this study looked at several real-world examples of AI applications in the healthcare industry. Consequently, it is critical to have a fundamental grasp of these ML and DL algorithms to be ready for upcoming advancements in AI. We have reviewed and classified scientific conference and journal articles used for various AI techniques and offer future utility as a comparative analysis for further research in healthcare sectors.

articleTitle: Enhancing Oral Cancer Screening with Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The majority of the conventional approaches used in current oral cancer screening methods, such as biopsy and visual inspection, result in late-stage detection, high false-positive/negative rates, and higher healthcare expenses. These techniques need specialized staff and are labor-intensive and subjective. To improve diagnostic speed and accuracy, the research offers a unique approach that makes use of deep learning methods, particularly Transformer models and Hybrid Neural Networks (HNNs). To enhance input quality, the system incorporates sophisticated image preparation methods such as data augmentation and normalization. While HNNs integrate Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) for robust feature extraction and temporal analysis, Transformers use attention techniques to extract contextual information. Its potential for early and accurate oral cancer detection is highlighted by the results, which show a significant improvement in detection accuracy (94% vs. 80-85% in existing systems), sensitivity (90% vs. 70-78%), and specificity (92% vs. 75-82%), along with a reduction in processing time to just 2 minutes.

articleTitle: Measuring the Corporate Social Responsibility Initiatives of Companies in Uttarakhand, India
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: The reputation of corporations is critical to their survival and growth. Internationally, the corporate world is going through a transition as organizations increasingly adopt strategies to incorporate more ethical and socially responsible behavior. CSR is a guide for making corporations socially responsible and fulfilling their moral obligations to the community surrounding their business operations and society in general. This research has been carried out within the framework of CSR, frequently referred to as a crucial movement, leading organizations to leave a positive societal change and not behaving merely as a profitable tool. Unquestionably, CSR plays an important role in sustainability, especially for developing nations, which will play major roles in global social development and their businesses. Therefore, organizations must participate in social and environmental initiatives and incorporate them into their strategic plans to accomplish sustainable growth and development. The objective of this study is to explore the CSR practices of the companies in Uttarakhand, mainly focusing on the community, employees, customers and suppliers, and the environment. We collected primary data from 146 companies by using a questionnaire to record their responses. We analyzed the data using SPSS statistics and SPSS Amos software, employing the SEM method.

articleTitle: Leveraging Blockchain for Secure Data Sharing and Cloud Computing: Implementing Distributed Timestamping with Machine Learning and Cryptographic Protocols
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing, Sciences and Communications (ICCSC)
abstract: In the last ten years-blockchain technology has changed a lot. It started as basic records shared across many computers and has become advanced networks that can do many things. Therefore, this study looks at how well blockchain systems can handle complex math problems for security. We focus on creating a system that puts timestamps on events. This method combines Schnorr signatures and Pedersen commitments. We use the Ethereum network to store and check data. The system uses a smart contract to manage data and connect servers and clients. Servers put timestamps on events and clients send data to be timestamped and checked. This setup makes sure they are clear and reliable. However, the study tests how well the system works by looking at cost-how much memory it uses and how fast it runs. The study also talks about using Ethereum. Ethereum lets everyone see timestamps and what happen-which is good for trust. But it can't keep secrets-so it's not good for private data. This study shows that blockchain is useful for more than just money. It can make sure events are real and safe. By mixing math ideas in blockchain-the study shows how to make data safer and more reliable in many places.
